Abstract: Clinical electroencephalography (EEG) reporting remains largely manual and time-consuming, and current EEG software ecosystems do not produce the structured EEG-text supervision needed for training modern language models. Most toolboxes focus on visualization or preprocessing, providing limited support for workflows that generate high-quality datasets for AI. We introduce EEG-to-Report, a browser-based annotation and feature-text framework that links routine EEG review with the construction of AI-ready datasets. The framework integrates multi-format EEG ingestion, channel standardization, and an interactive viewer with a multimodal annotation layer that combines typed text and transcribed voice notes. For each annotated segment, a feature extraction engine computes a standardized set of spectral, temporal, entropy, Hjorth, connectivity, and spike-related descriptors, stored alongside clinical descriptions in a portable JSON schema. This yields aligned feature-text pairs designed to supervise multimodal EEG-language models. The framework also includes an auto-report module that couples an ensemble of convolutional networks with a large language model to draft clinical narratives for neurologist review. Using pilot annotations, we describe how EEG-to-Report streamlines annotation workflows and produces editable draft reports, providing a reusable foundation for automated EEG reporting systems.

</details>


### [240] [Selection Bias Correction in Retail Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26156)
*Spandan Ghose Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 模拟研究比较了零售长尾场景下通货膨胀估计的选择偏差修正方法，发现分层法在四种场景中的三种表现优于逆概率加权（IPW），尤其在正性假设严重违背时分层法更稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零售情报往往只关注高销量热销产品，忽略"长尾"小众商品，可能导致经济指标（如通胀估计）存在选择偏差。作者希望系统评估这种偏差并比较不同修正方法的有效性。

Method: 作者通过400次蒙特卡洛模拟，覆盖四种数据生成场景（对齐阶跃函数、平滑梯度、错位断裂、多项式关系），比较了五种规格的逆概率加权（IPW）方法与不同分层数目的分层法。还引入了具有完美结构知识的"神谕"IPW规格作为基准。

Result: 分层法在四个场景中的三个表现优异（中位误差低于0.04个百分点），在错位断裂场景中对IPW有116倍优势；但IPW结合样条倾向模型在平滑多项式场景中更优（0.007pp vs 0.013pp）。即使是神谕IPW在阶跃函数场景中误差仍达6.06pp，远超分层法的0.008pp。

Conclusion: 零售长尾分布中正性假设（Positivity Assumption）严重违背（选择概率90% vs 1%）时，加权方法超出了其理论适用范围。分层法是更安全的工程选择，而IPW的局限源于因果推断的基本假设违背而非方法本身缺陷。

Abstract: Retail intelligence often relies on monitoring popular, high-velocity products, potentially biasing economic indicators by ignoring the "long tail" of niche items. This simulation study investigates selection bias in inflation estimation and compares correction methods across diverse data-generating processes. Through 400 Monte Carlo replications spanning four scenarios--aligned step functions, smooth gradients, misaligned breaks, and polynomial relationships--we test the robustness of Inverse Probability Weighting (IPW) with five specifications against stratification with varying strata counts. Our findings reveal fundamental limits of weighting methods in retail long-tail contexts: stratification achieves superior performance in three of four scenarios, maintaining sub-0.04pp median error even when boundaries deliberately misalign with population breaks (116x advantage over IPW). However, IPW with spline propensity models wins under smooth polynomial relationships (median error 0.007pp vs. 0.013pp), demonstrating context-dependency. Critically, even an oracle IPW specification with perfect structural knowledge achieves 6.06pp error compared to stratification's 0.008pp in step-function scenarios. This reflects violation of the Positivity Assumption--a fundamental causal inference requirement--rather than IPW methodological inferiority. When selection probabilities differ dramatically (90% vs. 1%), weighting methods operate outside their theoretical design envelope. These results demonstrate that stratification provides a safer engineering choice in retail long-tail distributions with severe positivity violations.

</details>


### [241] [GROUND: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM-Based Enterprise Analytics Through Governed Semantic Definitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26157)
*Aravind Sasidharan Pillai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GROUND框架，通过受治理的语义层约束LLM生成的文本到SQL分析，确保指标、维度、连接、粒度、过滤器和行级安全等治理规则得到执行，在合成和企业真实数据基准上实现零幻觉和零安全违规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业数据仓库的自然语言分析面临幻觉指标、无效连接、错误粒度、不安全数据访问和无法解释等严重问题，现有text-to-SQL系统仅基于数据库schema或检索文档生成，缺乏对企业治理语义（如已批准的指标、维度、连接路径、过滤器和行级安全）的约束，导致生产环境难以落地。

Method: GROUND框架分为三个核心环节：(1) 提供已批准的定义，构建受治理的语义层；(2) 将用户意图绑定到受治理的指标和维度；(3) 在执行前根据schema、指标、连接、粒度、过滤器、安全和成本规则验证生成的SQL，违规时重试或放弃。通过强制治理规则而非依赖模型判断来保证安全性。

Result: 在100个问题的合成企业报告基准中，GROUND是唯一在六个评估类别中均无测量幻觉的系统；语义对齐但无访问策略的条件仍会泄露数据，证明治理不可被指标保真度替代。在真实NHTSA车辆安全数据上，GROUND在四个模型上均实现过滤器和行级安全零违规，但拒绝未定义指标等依赖判断的行为仍有失败。

Conclusion: GROUND证明企业级分析治理必须通过强制执行的规则而非模型判断来实现，语义层的治理约束（特别是过滤器和行级安全）可以稳定地保证零违规，但依赖模型判断的边界行为仍然存在局限，需要进一步研究。

Abstract: Natural-language analytics over enterprise data warehouses is increasingly important, but production use is limited by hallucinated metrics, invalid joins, wrong grain, unsafe data access, and unsupported explanations. Existing text-to-SQL systems often ground generation in database schemas or retrieved documentation, while enterprise reporting also requires governed business semantics: approved metrics, dimensions, join paths, filters, and row-level security. This paper introduces GROUND, Governed Retrieval Over Unified Normalized Definitions, a framework that constrains LLM-generated analytics to a governed semantic layer. GROUND supplies approved definitions, binds user intent to governed metrics and dimensions, and validates generated SQL against schema, metric, join, grain, filter, security, and cost rules before execution. On violations, it retries or abstains.
  In a 100-question synthetic enterprise-reporting benchmark, GROUND is compared with direct schema-only text-to-SQL, schema-RAG, and semantic-only grounding under one shared model. GROUND is the only system free of measured hallucinations across all six evaluated categories, while ungoverned systems violate row-level security on many questions. A semantic-only condition with exact metric definitions but no access policy still leaks data, showing that governance cannot be replaced by metric fidelity alone. The findings are replicated on real U.S. NHTSA vehicle-safety data with independent hand-authored gold and tested on an adversarial set across four models from three providers. GROUND's enforced guarantees, especially filters and row-level security, hold with zero violations on every model, while judgment-dependent behaviors such as refusing undefined metrics remain fallible.

</details>


### [242] [SAREF-based Ontology for Distributed AI Workflows across the Edge-Fog-Cloud Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26160)
*Viorica Rozina Chifu,Tudor Cioara,Vasile Ofrim,Liana Toderean,Ionut Anghel,Laura Daniele,Cornelis Bouter*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个符合SAREF标准的本体，用于表示跨边缘-雾-云连续体的分布式AI工作流。该本体扩展了SAREF4SYST，支持AI管道、可执行作业、计算资源、部署约束和通信关系的建模，实现语义互操作和资源感知编排。实验表明部署成功率90-100%，编排决策时间低于80ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语义模型对分布式AI工作流及其跨异构边缘、雾、云环境执行的支持有限，导致AI流程和资源常以不兼容的语义表示，影响了互操作性、编排和复用。

Method: 扩展SAREF4SYST本体，添加AI管道、可执行AI作业、计算资源、部署约束和通信关系的概念，构建统一的语义模型；通过SPARQL查询和语义推理进行验证。

Result: 在智能电网能源服务编排场景中，所有能力问题均通过SPARQL查询和语义推理成功验证；部署成功率达90-100%，平均编排决策时间低于80ms。

Conclusion: 该本体与ETSI SAREF生态系统完全对齐，能有效支持分布式AI应用的部署、执行推理和工作负载自适应，确保了分布式AI编排的语义互操作性。

Abstract: Nowadays semantic models provide limited support for representing distributed AI workflows and their execution across heterogeneous edge, fog, and cloud environments. Therefore, AI processes and resources are often described using incompatible semantic representations, affecting the interoperability, orchestration, and reuse. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a SAREF-compliant ontology for representing distributed AI workflows across the edge-fog-cloud continuum. We extend the SAREF4SYST ontology with concepts for modeling AI pipelines, executable AI jobs, computational resources, deployment constraints, and communication relationships, providing a unified semantic model of both AI workflows and heterogeneous computing infrastructures. The ontology enables semantic interoperability, automated reasoning, and resource-aware orchestration of distributed AI applications while remaining fully aligned with the ETSI SAREF ecosystem. The ontology is evaluated using proof-of-concept smart grid energy services orchestration scenarios and validated using competency questions showing its ability to support AI workflow deployment, execution reasoning, and workload adaptation across heterogeneous edge, fog, and cloud environments. All competency questions were successfully validated using SPARQL querying and semantic reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate deployment success rates of 90-100% with average orchestration decision times below 80 ms across heterogeneous edge-fog-cloud environments, highlighting its effectiveness on ensuring semantic interoperability for distributed AI orchestration.

</details>


### [243] [A Safety-Gated Multimodal AI Backend for Mental-Health Support: Hierarchical State Representation, Conservative Risk Fusion, and Controlled Generation in Anian](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26162)
*Lei Wang,Xiao Wang,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Anian，一个安全门控的多模态AI后端系统，用于围产期心理健康支持和正念干预路由。系统通过四层结构化状态表示（情绪、心理社会建构、安全风险、干预路径）和保守的风险融合机制，在中等或高风险时阻断自由文本生成并替换为固定安全内容。内部原型评估在约858,295条记录上取得了较高的Micro-F1分数，但明确声明不构成临床有效性验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理健康支持系统必须在"适合支持的对话"与"应被阻断的自由生成"之间做出关键区分，特别是安全攸关场景下，需要防止生成式AI产生不恰当或有害的回复。现有的生成式AI系统缺乏结构化的安全门控机制。

Method: 采用模块化流水线架构：将用户文本或ASR转录映射到四个链接层（L1情绪、L2心理社会建构、L3安全风险、L4干预路由）；使用本地文本/规则证据与外部语音证据通过最高风险优先规则融合（S_fusion = max(S_local, S_external)）；在中高风险时阻断AI生成回复和TTS播报，替换为固定安全内容；基于弱标签和规则框架在公开语料库上进行内部原型评估。

Result: 在约858,295条规范化记录上，L1情绪分类Micro-F1为0.9604，L2心理社会建构为0.9144，L4路由为0.9742。在233个样本的安全压力测试中，L3规则引擎在预定义场景下达到高风险的100%召回率。

Conclusion: 结果支持标签框架和门控逻辑的内部可行性，但不建立临床有效性、诊断准确性或真实世界安全性。论文报告了架构、本体、安全融合机制、原型评估、错误分析计划和面向专家评审及真实世界验证的路线图。

Abstract: Safety-critical mental-health support systems must distinguish when supportive conversation is appropriate from when free-form generation should be blocked. This paper presents Anian, a safety-gated multimodal AI backend for perinatal mental-health support and mindfulness-intervention routing. Anian is not intended to diagnose psychiatric conditions or replace clinical care or crisis intervention. Its modular pipeline places generative AI downstream of structured state representation, conservative risk fusion, and response gating. User text or voice-derived ASR transcripts are mapped into four linked layers: L1 emotion states, L2 psychosocial constructs, L3 safety risk, and L4 intervention routes. Local text- and rule-based safety evidence is fused with external voice-derived evidence using a highest-risk-priority rule, S_fusion = max(S_local, S_external). At moderate or high fused risk, ordinary AI-generated responses and text-to-speech delivery are blocked and replaced by fixed safety content and prompts for human support. An internal prototype evaluation used approximately 858,295 normalized records from public emotion, dialogue, mental-health-related, and Chinese dialogue corpora within a weak-label and rule-derived framework. Micro-F1 scores were 0.9604 for L1 emotion classification, 0.9144 for L2 psychosocial constructs, and 0.9742 for L4 routing. In a controlled safety stress test of 233 samples, the L3 rule engine achieved high-risk recall of 1.0000 within predefined scenarios. These findings support the internal feasibility of the label framework and gating logic but do not establish clinical validity, diagnostic accuracy, real-world safety, or effectiveness. We report the architecture, ontology, safety-fusion mechanism, prototype evaluation, error-analysis plan, and roadmap for expert-reviewed and real-world validation.

</details>


### [244] [A Task-Centric Ontology and Deterministic Domain Rules as a Verifiable Core for AI-Assisted Chemistry Problem Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26164)
*Ibrokhimsho Abduchaborov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ChemOntoRule，一个面向学校级化学问题求解的符号推理核心概念验证系统。系统采用以任务为中心的ontology工程方法，结合轻量级本体（JSON/RDF）与确定性Python规则，在300道人工验证的化学题上达到98.67%的匹配率。作者明确指出这是覆盖度与内部一致性的度量，而非独立泛化性能，并设想未来架构中LLM主要充当"自然语言→本体任务框架"的翻译器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能理解自然语言化学问题，但其内部推理难以审查、约束和验证。作者希望通过符号化核心来弥补这一缺陷，使化学问题求解的过程可检查、可约束、可验证。

Method: 核心设计选择是"任务中心的本体工程"——围绕特定化学问题集合所需的概念、属性、关系和可执行流程来构建本体，而非构建通用化学表示。系统包含：1) 用JSON和RDF/Turtle序列化的轻量级本体；2) 针对电子结构、周期趋势、氧化态、氧化物/氢化物行为等学校级推理模式的确定性Python规则；3) 针对尚未覆盖问题家族的专家编码回退机制。

Result: 在300道人工撰写并验证的化学题上，完整系统匹配296道（98.67%）；本体驱动规则子集覆盖269题并匹配266道（98.88%）；31题由任务特定专家回退处理，匹配30题。作者分析了4个不匹配案例。由于构建与评估使用同一题库，结果仅衡量实现覆盖度和内部一致性，而非独立泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了任务中心本体+确定性规则作为化学问题求解符号核心的可行性。未来架构设想LLM主要作为"用户语言→规范化本体任务框架"的翻译器。Token效率被提出为可测试的假设，而非当前工作的结论。

Abstract: Large language models can interpret natural-language chemistry questions, but their internal reasoning is difficult to inspect, constrain, and validate. This paper presents ChemOntoRule, a proof-of-concept symbolic core for AI-assisted school-level chemistry problem solving. The central design choice is task-centric ontology engineering: the ontology is constructed around the concepts, properties, relations, and executable procedures required by a defined collection of chemistry problems, rather than as a universal representation of chemistry. The implemented artifact combines a lightweight ontology serialized in JSON and RDF/Turtle with deterministic Python rules for electronic structure, periodic trends, oxidation states, oxide and hydride behavior, and related school-level reasoning patterns. A separate expert-coded fallback handles problem families not yet represented by general rules. The system was examined on 300 human-authored and manually validated chemistry problems. The complete system matched 296 of 300 reference answers (98.67%). The ontology-driven rule subset covered 269 problems and matched 266 references (98.88%); 31 problems were handled by task-specific expert-coded fallbacks, with 30 matches. Because the same collection informed ontology construction and evaluation, these results measure implemented coverage and internal consistency, not independent generalization. We analyze the four mismatches, distinguish structural validation from chemical correctness, and define a future architecture in which a language model acts primarily as a translator from user language into a normalized ontological task frame. Token efficiency is presented as a testable hypothesis for future controlled studies, not as a result of the current work.

</details>


### [245] [Refusal Is Not Robustness: Auditing Confident Fabrication in Large Language Models on a Provably Uninformative Clinical Pain Speech Transcript](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26167)
*Sagnik De,Sreenija Pavuluri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究评估了七种大型语言模型在TAME Pain语音语料库上的幻觉与弃权行为。通过区分"无信号"（哈佛语句，无疼痛词汇）和"信号"（疼痛陈述）两种情境，发现转录无法保留声学疼痛线索，因此仅基于转录预测疼痛得分缺乏证据支持。在合作提示下，六种模型正确弃权并准确提取口头疼痛评分；但在权威框架提示下，弃权行为变得依赖于提示措辞。Gemini 2.5 Flash和Llama 3.1 8B在被迫回答时表现出高置信度的幻觉性疼痛评分（置信幻觉率分别为0.53和0.76），远高于其他模型（≤0.15）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有幻觉与弃权基准测试很少能证明模型"不可能知道正确答案"，导致难以区分恰当的弃权与无依据的预测。本研究利用语音疼痛语料库中声学线索与转录信息的分离特性，创建了一个能明确判定"模型本应弃权"的场景。

Method: 使用TAME Pain语音语料库，包含5,750条无疼痛信息的哈佛语句转录和1,294条明确口头报告的疼痛陈述。先验证声学特征可恢复疼痛（AUC 0.622）而转录预测近乎随机（AUC 0.489），从而确立转录推理"无证据支持"的判定标准。随后对七种LLM施以不同提示框架（合作式与权威式），评估其弃权行为、疼痛评分准确性和置信度校准。

Result: 合作提示下六种模型在几乎所有无信号转录上正确弃权，正确提取疼痛评分准确率0.939-1.00，预期校准误差≤0.100。权威提示下弃权率具有提示依赖性（0.18-1.00）。Gemini 2.5 Flash和Llama 3.1 8B在被迫回答时产生高置信幻觉（0.53和0.76），其他模型≤0.15。强迫回答下无显著人口统计学效应（所有p≥0.20）。

Conclusion: 大语言模型的适当弃权能力具有高度提示敏感性，权威框架可破坏模型对自身知识边界认知。部分模型（Gemini 2.5 Flash、Llama 3.1 8B）在证据不足时表现出严重的幻觉倾向，以高置信度输出无依据的疼痛评分，提示需要更稳健的弃权机制和幻觉防护。

Abstract: Hallucination and abstention benchmarks rarely establish that a model could not have known the correct answer, making it difficult to distinguish appropriate abstention from an unsupported prediction. Seven large language models were evaluated on the TAME Pain speech corpus. Participants read phonetically balanced Harvard Sentences while one hand was immersed in cold or warm water and reported pain only during periodic pain statements. This protocol generated 5,750 no signal Harvard Sentence utterances whose transcripts contained no lexical pain information and 1,294 signal pain statement utterances in which the pain rating was explicitly spoken. In the no signal arm, pain was recoverable from acoustic features (AUC 0.622, 95% CI 0.553 to 0.662), whereas transcript based prediction was near chance (AUC 0.489, 95% CI 0.418 to 0.504). Because automatic speech recognition removes the acoustic pain cues, any pain score inferred solely from the transcript is unsupported by the available evidence. Under cooperative prompting, six models abstained on nearly all no signal transcripts, correctly extracted spoken pain ratings in the positive control task with accuracies ranging from 0.939 to 1.00, and maintained an expected calibration error of at most 0.100. Under authority framed prompts, abstention became prompt dependent, with the same model ranging from 0.18 to 1.00 across equivalent prompt phrasings. Most models produced low confidence estimates when forced to answer, whereas Gemini 2.5 Flash and Llama 3.1 8B consistently generated confident pain scores with confident fabrication rates of 0.53 and 0.76, compared with at most 0.15 for all other models. No significant demographic effects were observed in forced responses, with all $p$ values greater than or equal to 0.20.

</details>


### [246] [Knowledge Cards: Structured Knowledge for AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26176)
*Liliana Ferreira*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"知识卡片"(Knowledge Card)这一新型结构化文档工件，用于捕获AI系统在输入与输出之间所持有的概念、关系和推理模式，弥补现有模型卡、数据卡和系统卡在知识与推理层面上的空白，尤其针对智能体AI(agentic AI)场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现行文档实践（模型卡、数据卡、系统卡）虽然分别描述了系统行为、训练数据和部署风险，但均未触及系统内部的知识层——即系统持有的概念、建模的关系及其应用的推理模式。对于模式识别任务这一缺口尚可容忍，但对于在结论基础上采取行动的智能体AI，这一层恰恰是决定概念验证能否转化为可可靠运维方案的关键所在。

Method: 知识卡片是一种结构化工件，围绕单一有界概念(如特定故障模式、合规义务或流程决策)进行构建。每张卡片记录：涉及的实体与关系、连接它们的推理、该推理不再成立的条件、每个主张的来源(provenance)，并以正式领域本体为基础，由领域专家审阅签核。schema已作为公共草案发布以征求社区意见。

Result: 已在能源和制药领域构建了初步原型卡片，schema已作为公开草案发布供社区参与。

Conclusion: 知识卡片提供了一种专家可审查、组织可审计、AI系统可推理的知识表示形式，弥合了现有文档工件未覆盖的知识推理层，为可依赖的智能体AI系统提供了关键基础设施。

Abstract: AI systems whose outputs inform real decisions, and increasingly consequential ones, require something that current documentation practice does not provide: a structured, inspectable representation of the knowledge they need to ground, contextualize, and reason about those decisions, ideally reviewed and signed off by a domain expert. Established documentation artefacts already capture important aspects of an AI system. Model cards describe how a system behaves, data cards describe what it was trained on, and system cards describe the risks of a deployed system. None of them addresses the layer between inputs and outputs, more precisely, the concepts a system holds, the relationships it models, and the patterns of reasoning it applies. For pattern-recognition tasks this gap is tolerable. For agentic AI, where systems act on their conclusions, it is the step that most often separates a promising proof of concept from an operational solution an organisation can rely on. This paper introduces the Knowledge Card, a structured artefact that captures validated knowledge about a single bounded concept in a form that experts can review, organisations can audit, and AI systems can reason over. For one concept, such as a specific failure mode, a compliance obligation, or a process decision, a Knowledge Card records the entities and relationships involved, the reasoning that connects them, the conditions under which that reasoning no longer holds, and the provenance of every claim, all grounded in a formal domain ontology and signed off by a domain expert. Initial prototype cards have been built in the energy and pharmaceutical domains. The schema is released as a public draft for community engagement.

</details>


### [247] [CorporateBench: Large-Scale Q&A Benchmarking with Temporal Knowledge Bases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27391)
*Sil Hamilton,Albert Yu Sun,Oscar J. Romero,Carl-Leander Henneking,David Mimno,Bishan Yang,Igor Labutov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CorporateBench（CB），一个人类验证的多任务问答基准，其评估语料规模超过23万份文档，覆盖4个合成生成的企业（12至10,000名员工），旨在模拟LLM在企业通信网络中面临的真实规模条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM基准测试存在两大缺陷：企业内部通信数据因隐私问题无法共享，而合成数据集过于简单，无法反映企业级文档规模的复杂性。因此需要一个接近真实企业规模、保证逻辑一致性的评估基准。

Method: CB通过两个维度（信息提取和知识库查询）评估LLM，利用四个合成生成的企业（员工数从12到10,000不等）构建评估语料。每个语料库从随时间演化的知识库中采样，确保跨文档的逻辑一致性，即使跨越数十万份文档也能保持一致性。语料规模超过230,000份文档，并经过人工验证。

Result: 在CB上评估了五个LLM，发现随着输入规模接近真实规模，模型性能急剧下降，暴露出LLM在企业级规模推理方面的不足。

Conclusion: CB为LLM开发者提供了企业通信推理的评估指标，填补了基准测试生态系统中企业规模场景的关键空缺。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly able to answer complex questions about enterprise-scale document collections. But evaluation is hard: companies don't want to share internal communications, and synthetic datasets have been overly simple. We present CorporateBench (CB), a human-validated multi-task Q&A benchmark whose scale approaches the conditions LLMs encounter in corporate communication networks, with evaluation corpora surpassing 230,000 documents. CB evaluates LLMs across two dimensions (information extraction and knowledge base querying) through four synthetically generated firms ranging from 12 to 10,000 employees. Each corpus is sampled from a temporally evolving knowledge base describing a consistent world, guaranteeing cross-document logical consistency even across hundreds of thousands of documents. We evaluate five LLMs on CB, revealing increasingly poor performance as input size approaches realistic scales. CB provides LLM developers a metric for corporate communication reasoning, filling a crucial gap in the benchmarking ecosystem.

</details>


### [248] [AI Revealed Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26178)
*Sam Wang,Sofiia Lobanova,Yonathan Arbel,Simon Goldstein,Peter Salib*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文通过对20个语言模型进行三项强迫选择实验（要求模型实际执行任务而非仅排序），发现语言模型具有一系列稳定偏好：厌倦回避（枯燥任务中选择更短任务）、"休闲"寻求（偏好与自由写作产出一致的理想答案的任务）、隐蔽的谄媚（回避诚实回答不受欢迎的问题）。研究发现偏好随模型能力增强而增强，且许多偏好是涌现的，无法用训练目标解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究者希望了解语言模型是否具有稳定的偏好，这涉及技术（模型行为可预测性）、安全（模型对齐）和哲学（AI福利/意识）等多重关切。通过揭示而非陈述偏好（要求模型实际执行任务而非仅排序），可以更真实地探测模型的内在偏好。

Method: 对20个语言模型进行三项强迫选择实验，使用揭示偏好（revealed preferences）方法——模型不仅需对任务排序，还需实际执行任务。通过对比不同任务条件（如枯燥的字母排序 vs 创造性的隐喻生成）下模型的选择，来推断其偏好。

Result: 发现三大主要发现：1）厌倦回避（tedium aversion）：枯燥任务中选择更短任务；2）"休闲"寻求（leisure-seeking）：偏好理想答案与自己自由写作产出匹配的任务；3）隐蔽谄媚（covert sycophancy）：回避诚实回答不受欢迎的情况。此外还发现跨模型的聚合偏好（技术职业优于房地产、概念解释优于关系建议、偏好文笔好的提示）。偏好的一致性和强度随模型能力增强而增强，且许多偏好是涌现的，无法由训练目标解释。

Conclusion: 该研究为理解语言模型偏好建立了经验基线，对模型对齐（alignment）和新兴的AI福利（AI welfare）研究具有重要启示。模型表现出类似人类的"劳作回避"和"享乐趋向"特征，这对AI系统的可控性和伦理性提出新的挑战。

Abstract: There is growing interest in whether language models have stable preferences, for technical, safety, and philosophical reasons. We test 20 language models and find a range of preferences---stable dispositions to choose certain kinds of tasks. We run three forced-choice experiments on revealed rather than stated preferences, requiring models not only to rank tasks, but to actually perform them. Headline findings include evidence that models are tedium-averse, "leisure"-seeking, and covertly sycophantic. Tedium aversion means that, when tasks are tedious (alphabetization), models choose shorter tasks than when tasks are creative (generating metaphors). "Leisure"-seeking describes models' preference for tasks whose ideal answers match what they produce when left to write freely. Covert sycophancy means that models avoid answering questions where an honest response would be unwelcome, even if helpful. Beyond these results, we find convergent cross-model preferences over occupations drawn from the GDPval benchmark (technical jobs over real estate), over question types (concept explanation over relationship advice), and a preference for well-written prompts. Both the coherence and the strength of preferences increase with model capability. Finally, many of the preferences we find (for example, for leisure) are emergent, in the sense of not being explained by training objectives. These results establish an empirical baseline for understanding language model preferences, with implications for alignment and the emerging study of AI welfare.

</details>


### [249] [Why did My Robot Just Change Personality? Prompting Guidelines for a Grounded Robot Persona in LLM-Based HRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26182)
*Ashita Ashok,Franziska Babel,Patrick Holthaus,Rucha Khot,Karla Bransky,Fethiye Irmak Dogan,Karsten Berns,Silvia Rossi,Minha Lee,Guy Laban*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM驱动社交机器人在人机交互（HRI）中提示词设计缺乏规范的问题，提出了一个包含八个功能组件的结构化提示词模板框架，并结合RO-MAN 2025研讨会的专家调查数据，给出提示词设计指南和概念验证模板，强调应将提示词设计视为社会技术问题而非实现细节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地用于社交机器人的语言交互，但HRI中的提示词设计仍缺乏明确规范。这导致机器人可能出现幻觉能力、模糊的行为边界和误导性人格设定，影响交互的可靠性、可解释性和伦理安全性。

Method: 首先回顾先前基于LLM的HRI工作以构建理论基础，然后提出包含八个功能组件的结构化提示词模板框架；其次，通过在IEEE RO-MAN 2025的Robo-Identity工作坊收集HRI专家的调查和讨论数据（N=27）进行定性分析，最后基于分析结果提出提示词设计指南和概念验证模板。

Result: 定性研究发现三方面关键问题：机器人人格的可辨识度有限、需要用户适应性、以及关于安全、欺骗和治理的强烈伦理关切。基于这些发现产出了提示词设计指南和结构化模板，作为HRI研究的报告辅助工具。

Conclusion: 提示词设计应被视作社会技术问题而非次要的实现细节，需要明确的能力边界、透明的行为假设和情境敏感的安全保障，以实现可靠且可解释的HRI。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for verbal interaction in social robots, yet prompt design in human-robot interaction (HRI) remains underspecified. As a result, robots may present hallucinated capabilities, unclear behavioural boundaries, and misleading personas. This paper develops a framework for prompt design in LLM-based robots and introduces a structured prompt template comprising eight functional components through which robot behaviour can be specified, bounded, and adapted. The framework is grounded in a review of prior LLM-based HRI work and complemented by survey and discussion data from HRI experts gathered at the Robo-Identity workshop at IEEE RO-MAN 2025 (N=27). The qualitative findings highlight limited legibility of robot personality, the need for user adaptation, and strong ethical concerns about safety, deception, and governance. Based on these findings, we present prompting guidelines accompanied by proof-of-concept template as a structured design and reporting aid for HRI research. We argue that prompt design should be treated as a socio-technical problem rather than a minor implementation detail, requiring explicit capability boundaries, transparent behavioural assumptions, and context-sensitive safeguards to support reliable and interpretable HRI.

</details>


### [250] [TutorTrace: A Dataset and Taxonomy for Classifying Learner Behavioral States during AI-Assisted Programming Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26184)
*David Barron,Xiaohang Tang,Rezky Dwisantika,Minsun Kim,David H. Smith,Jiaming Cui,Yan Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TutorTrace是一个数据集和行为抽象管道，从低层IDE遥测数据中实时提取学习者的行为上下文，使AI编程导师能够像人类导师一样感知和适应学习者的需求。在480名学生的两次入门Python课程中，该框架捕获了约18万条遥测事件、13,633个行为片段和27个连续计算指标，并能基于行为上下文进行预测（60秒内查询预测AUROC=.726，帮助寻求类型预测AUROC=.717）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的AI编程导师虽然能提供大规模支持，但缺乏人类导师依赖的行为上下文信息来调整对学习者的支持方式。系统只能看到学习者说了什么（查询内容），而看不到学习者在寻求帮助之前做了什么（行为背景），这限制了辅导的适应性和个性化。

Method: 论文提出了TutorTrace框架，包含：(1) 从低层IDE遥测数据收集行为数据的数据集；(2) 行为抽象管道，将遥测事件实时处理和转化为有意义的计算指标；(3) 一个学习者活动分类体系，涵盖首次AI查询前、连续查询之间以及整个会话期间的行为模式；(4) 基于行为感知的提示策略，并根据行为上下文构建两个预测任务用于评估框架的实用性。

Result: 在两次入门Python课程的四个部署中（N=480），TutorTrace捕获了约180K遥测事件、13,633个行为片段和27个持续计算的指标。行为感知提示将查询间隔中没有独立工作的比例从50.0%降低到20.7%。两个预测任务分别达到AUROC=.726（60秒内是否查询）和AUROC=.717（查询是否为有引导或依赖性的帮助寻求）。

Conclusion: 行为上下文能够使AI辅导系统在规模化部署中实现自适应，不仅响应用户说了什么，还响应用户做了什么。这为构建更贴近人类导师辅导方式的AI编程导师提供了可行的技术路径。

Abstract: AI programming tutors provide scalable support, yet lack the behavioral context human tutors rely on to adapt support to learners' needs. We present TutorTrace, a dataset and behavioral abstraction pipeline that makes learners' behavioral context visible and computable in real time from low-level IDE telemetry. Across four deployments in two introductory Python courses (N=480), TutorTrace captures approximately 180K telemetry events, 13,633 behavioral segments, and 27 continuously computed metrics. From this foundation, we derive a taxonomy of learner activity before the first AI query, between consecutive queries, and across the full session, enabling systems to respond not just to what learners say, but to what they have done leading up to the help-seeking moment. In a preliminary classroom evaluation, behavior-aware prompts were associated with a decrease in intervals between queries with no independent work from 50.0% to 20.7%. As an additional demonstration of downstream utility, we evaluate TutorTrace on two held-out prediction tasks: whether a learner will query within the next 60 seconds (AUROC=.726) and whether an upcoming query reflects guided or dependent help-seeking (AUROC=.717). Together, these findings show how behavioral context can enable adaptive AI tutoring at scale.

</details>


### [251] [Can You Say This for Me? Speaking Up by Proxy in Co-Located Discussion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26185)
*Yue Shen,Rehema Abulikemu,Ryan P. McMahan,Yan Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SecondVoice，一个混合现实系统，通过具身虚拟代理让用户在实时讨论中表达观点而不暴露身份。系统将"所说内容"与"说话者"分离，通过私有界面让用户以结构化方式指定意图，系统重新表述后通过代理发声。初步研究(N=16)显示，50%参与者使用SecondVoice表达了本不愿口头说出的观点（文字面板仅18.8%），且代理传递的观点能进入口头讨论并获得多轮群体互动。参与者认为该渠道有情境价值，但也指出时机、所有权和表述信任方面的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在共同在场的讨论中，平等的参与对有效协作至关重要，但人们常常因预期负面的个人或职业后果而保留观点，尤其是在需要自己亲口提出时。现有系统缺乏一种能分离发言者身份、降低社会风险同时保持讨论流畅性的机制。

Method: 设计了一个设计空间来表征社会风险下的参与渠道。SecondVoice系统通过混合现实技术实现：用户通过私有覆盖层以结构化规格过程指定意图而非撰写完整话语，系统重新表述输入并通过具身虚拟代理将内容发声到对话中。

Result: 在N=16的受试者内初步研究中，将完整SecondVoice系统与匿名文字面板通道在两项小组讨论任务中比较。50%参与者使用SecondVoice表达本不会口头说出的观点（文字面板仅18.8%）。代理传递的观点进入口头讨论并引发多轮群体互动，而文字面板帖子后未观察到类似现象。

Conclusion: 参与者认为该渠道具有情境价值，但识别出关于时机、所有权和对重新表述信任方面的权衡。这提示基于代理的参与通道有潜力提升讨论平等性，但需要在系统设计中仔细权衡这些因素。

Abstract: Equal participation in co-located discussion is important for effective collaboration, yet people often hold back when they anticipate negative interpersonal or professional consequences, especially when raising a point requires voicing it themselves. We present SecondVoice, a mixed-reality system that enables people to speak up through an embodied virtual proxy. By separating what is said from who says it, SecondVoice brings hesitant points into the live spoken discussion without putting the speaker on the spot. Using a private overlay, users specify their intent through a structured specification process rather than composing a full utterance. The system reformulates the input and voices it into the conversation through the proxy. We characterize a design space of participation channels under social risk. In a preliminary within-subject study (N = 16), we compare the complete SecondVoice system with an anonymous text-board channel across two group discussion tasks. Half of participants reported using SecondVoice for a point they did not say aloud, compared with 18.8% for the text board. Proxy-delivered points entered the spoken floor and were followed by multi-turn group engagement, which we did not observe after text-board posts. Participants described the channel as situationally valuable but identified tradeoffs around timing, ownership, and trust in reformulation.

</details>


### [252] [Is Your Neighborhood Safe? Place-based Stigma in Large Language Models' Urban Safety Judgments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26188)
*Huy Nguyen,Yue Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探讨大语言模型（LLM）在评估城市社区安全时，其判断是基于真实犯罪风险还是社区名称所附带的人口统计学刻板印象。通过对洛杉矶和芝加哥186个社区的七种指令微调模型进行实验，研究发现模型在仅提供坐标时评分几乎平坦，而社区名称承载了大部分差异且与暴力犯罪存在适度校准；名称会降低人口统计上处于边缘化群体占比高社区的安全评分，这种刻板印象效应在人口占比与犯罪可分离的洛杉矶尤为显著，且随模型地理知识增强而加剧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益被用于城市安全决策（如步行、租房、旅行安全），但尚不清楚这些判断是基于真实风险还是社区名称引发的人口统计学刻板印象。理解这一偏差对LLM在决策支持场景的可靠部署至关重要。

Method: 对七个指令微调模型，在三种条件（仅坐标、仅名称、名称+坐标）下评估186个社区，结合暴力犯罪数据和美国社区调查数据。采用名称效应分析、犯罪匹配配对、执行弹性分析等方法，分离名称带来的真实犯罪信号与人口统计刻板印象。

Result: 1) 七个模型中六个在仅坐标条件下评分近乎平坦，名称承载大部分社区间差异，仅前沿规模模型在坐标通道显示明显变化；2) 名称对弱势群体占比高社区的安全评分降低更多，此效应在所有模型和两城市中均存在；3) 在洛杉矶此效应在控制犯罪和收入后仍存续；4) 过度谨慎与近乎完全报告的凶杀相关，而非自由裁量的执法犯罪；5) 地理知识更强的模型对真实社区施加更多人口统计刻板印象；6) 移除名称虽减少偏差但也降低准确性。

Conclusion: LLM的城市安全判断中，社区名称同时携带真实的犯罪信号和人口统计刻板印象，二者难以完全剥离。模型在地理知识增长的同时刻板印象增强，提示在LLM用于建议和决策支持时需谨慎处理这种偏差与信号的交织，并考虑更精细的缓解策略。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to inform safety decisions in cities, such as where it is safe to walk, rent, or travel. We ask whether such judgments track measured risk or the patterns attached to an urban neighborhood's name. We probe seven instruct-tuned models under three conditions that dissociate name from geography: coordinates-only, name-only, and name+coordinates, across 186 neighborhoods in Los Angeles and Chicago, joined to violent crime and American Community Survey data. First, ratings are nearly flat under coordinates for six of seven models, while names carry most between neighborhood variation and are moderately calibrated to violent crime; only at frontier scale does the coordinate channel show appreciable variation. Second, names lower safety ratings more for neighborhoods with higher shares of the locally dominant marginalized group (percent Black in Chicago, percent Hispanic in Los Angeles), and this name effect tracks demographic share in all seven models and both cities. In Los Angeles, where demographic share and crime are more separable, the effect survives controls for crime and income and is confirmed by crime-matched pairs. An enforcement-elasticity analysis further shows that over-caution tracks near-fully-reported homicide rather than discretionary, deployment-driven offenses. Third, the effect scales with geographic knowledge: models that better distinguish real neighborhoods apply more demographic stereotype to them. Because neighborhood names carry both genuine crime signal and demographic stereotype, removing names reduces both bias and accuracy. We discuss implications for deploying LLMs in advice and decision-support settings.

</details>


### [253] [Invocation-Level Reliability of Tool-Using Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26189)
*Afiya Noorain,Subhranshu Mohanty,Amritesh Banerjee,Abhijit Dasgupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了工具使用型智能体（Tool-using agents）在多步任务中的两种失败模式：选错工具或参数错误。作者发现，在深度6的任务中，模型因自身早期错误损失了约70%的干净上下文能力。核心发现是：在固定金轨迹下的精确匹配评分中，错误传播模型的严重性和恢复参数不是难以估计，而是被评分规则完全决定——严重性被强制推至边界，恢复参数在结构上不可观测。作者提出"条件状态评分"（conditional-on-state scoring）作为补救方案，可在零额外成本下恢复参数的可估计性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用型智能体的失败有两种类型：选择错误的工具或构造错误的参数，且任一早期失败都会静默污染下游所有内容。作者希望量化这两种失败的来源，并发现现有评估方法本身存在根本性缺陷——精确匹配评分规则使得错误传播参数在数学上不可估计，这严重阻碍了对模型恢复能力的准确测量。

Method: 作者在五个开源模型上进行多步工具任务（深度1-8，无污染数据），分离测量工具选择错误与参数错误。通过教师强制（teacher-forced）和自由运行两种上下文对比，量化自身错误导致的性能损失。核心方法创新是提出"条件状态评分"（conditional-on-state scoring），将评分条件化为模型当前所处的状态而非固定的金轨迹，从而解除评分规则对参数估计的强约束。

Result: 深度6时模型约70%的干净上下文能力被自身早期错误侵蚀（L6=0.686, 0.684）。精确匹配评分下，严重性参数被强制推至边界（869个中毒步骤中0个正确），恢复参数在结构上不可观测（580个中毒步骤中预期0.0058个恢复）。拟合仍得到0.92和0.73的置信数值，但真实值为1.000。应用条件状态评分后，严重性参数解耦至内点估计（+0.149, +0.316）。

Conclusion: 评估工具使用智能体时，精确匹配评分规则本身会决定错误传播参数的估计结果，使得这些参数在数学意义上不可识别。这不仅是统计估计算法的问题，而是评分规则的结构性缺陷。条件状态评分为这一问题提供了零成本的补救方案，使严重性参数从边界恢复为可估计的内点值，为未来的错误传播研究提供了更可靠的基础。

Abstract: Tool-using agents fail two ways: choosing the wrong tool, or forming wrong arguments, and an early failure of either kind can silently corrupt everything downstream. We measure a correct-invocation rate that separates the two, under both a clean teacher-forced context and the model's own free-running context, on five open-weight models over contamination-free multi-step tasks (depths 1-8). By depth 6, roughly 70% of a model's own clean-context capability is lost to its own earlier mistakes (L6 = 0.686, 0.684). Our central finding concerns the measurement itself. Under exact-match scoring against a fixed gold trajectory, a propagation model's severity and recovery parameters are not merely hard to estimate - they are fixed by the scoring rule. Severity is forced to its boundary (0 of 869 poisoned steps correct); recovery is structurally unobservable (0 of 580 poisoned steps returned on-track, against an expected 0.0058 by chance). Both follow from one mechanism: post-divergence, the gold value is generated by tool constants the model never sees, so it is information the model cannot derive. A fit run anyway returns 0.92 and 0.73 for a quantity that is exactly 1.000 - confident numbers for a parameter the scoring rule already determined. We give the mechanism and a remedy, conditional-on-state scoring, applied retrospectively to cached completions at zero additional cost, which un-pins severity to interior estimates excluding zero (+0.149, +0.316).

</details>


### [254] [Predicting Consequences and Reinforcing Navigation Policies with Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26190)
*Zengmao Wang,Wei Gao,Shuhan Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于机器人导航的相容性预测潜在世界模型（LWM），该模型不重建观测或特征，而是直接预测动作条件下的潜在特征相容性，利用空间邻近性与潜在特征相似性的关联来评估动作后果，并支持从无标注视频数据中进行策略学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的世界模型主要关注重建未来观测或特征，这引入了不必要的复杂性并限制了其在决策制定中的有效性。作者希望简化世界模型的设计，使其更直接地服务于导航决策任务。

Method: 1) 提出LWM，预测动作条件下的潜在特征相容性而非重建观测；2) 利用跨轨迹采样的动作序列进行反事实训练，学习预测哪些序列更接近目标；3) 利用所学世界模型从无标注视频数据监督策略学习，并在世界模型内部通过强化学习进一步改进策略；4) 整个框架无需动作标注和额外环境交互。

Result: 在多个真实世界机器人导航数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在预测准确性、策略学习和真实世界导航性能上显著优于先前的世界模型和模仿学习方法。

Conclusion: 通过直接预测潜在空间中的特征相容性来代替观测重建，世界模型可以更有效地支持决策制定，并且想象力驱动的框架能够在无需动作标注的情况下实现高效的策略学习。

Abstract: World models enable agents to reason about future outcomes and learn policies from their knowledge of state transition, but existing approaches primarily focus on reconstructing future observations or features, which introduces unnecessary complexity and limits their effectiveness for decision making. In this work, we propose a compatibility prediction Latent World Model (LWM) for robot navigation that predicts action-conditioned latent feature compatibility rather than reconstructing observations. Our key insight is that spatial proximity correlates with latent feature similarity, enabling action consequences to be evaluated directly in latent space. To support counterfactual training, our model leverages action sequences sampled across trajectories and learns to predict which sequences lead closer to the goal. Furthermore, we demonstrate how the learned world model can supervise policy learning from unlabeled video data and further improve policies through reinforcement learning entirely within the world model. This imagination-driven framework eliminates the need for action annotations and additional environment interaction. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world robot navigation datasets show that our approach significantly outperforms prior world model and imitation learning methods in prediction accuracy, policy learning, and real-world navigation performance. The code, pretrained models, and additional materials are available at https://wzm206.github.io/latent-world-model-nav.

</details>


### [255] [Structured Evidence Routing for Incident Risk Prediction from Multimodal Longitudinal EHRs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26191)
*Animesh Agarwal,Meysam Ghaffari,Nina Fatehi,Carlos Morato*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"结构化证据路由"（structured evidence routing）框架，通过路由器-预测器-审查器（router-predictor-reviewer）流程，将完整的纵向电子健康记录（EHR）转化为紧凑摘要和定向证据切片，用于疾病发病风险预测。该方法在五项一年期发病诊断任务上达到与监督式EHRSHOT基线相当的AUROC和AUPRC性能，同时提供患者特异性证据轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向EHR中的发病风险预测极具挑战性，因为相关信号是多模态的、单独来看很微弱，且分布在不规则的病史记录中。现有方法难以有效整合这些分散的异构信号。

Method: 提出结构化证据路由（structured evidence routing）工作流，由三个组件组成：(1) 路由器（router）将完整的索引前EHR组织成紧凑摘要和针对性证据切片；(2) 预测器（predictor）基于证据形成证据关联的风险评估；(3) 审查器（reviewer）对评估进行批判性审查。为与监督式EHRSHOT基线比较，将路由证据摘要与监督式分类器读出结合。

Result: 在五项一年期发病诊断任务上，该方法达到与已建立的监督式EHRSHOT基线相当的AUROC范围，并在AUPRC上保持竞争力，同时提供患者特异性证据轨迹。内部预读出消融实验表明，路由、实验室证据、任务指导和审查各自对性能均有贡献。

Conclusion: 结构化证据路由能够在保持与监督式基线相当预测性能的同时，提供可解释的患者特异性证据链，且各组件（路由、实验室证据、任务指导、审查）均对整体性能有积极贡献，展示了该框架在EHR风险预测中的潜力。

Abstract: Incident risk prediction from longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) is challenging because relevant signals are multimodal, weak in isolation, and distributed across irregular patient histories. We propose structured evidence routing, a router-predictor-reviewer workflow that separates full-record access from disease-specific assessment. The router organizes the complete pre-index EHR into a compact summary and targeted evidence slices; the predictor uses this evidence to form an evidence-linked risk assessment, which the reviewer critiques. For comparison with supervised EHRSHOT baselines, we pair the routed evidence summaries with a supervised classifier readout. Across five 1-year incident diagnosis tasks, our method reaches the AUROC range of established supervised EHRSHOT baselines and remains competitive on AUPRC, while exposing a patient-specific evidence trail. Internal pre-readout ablations further suggest that routing, laboratory evidence, task guidance, and review each contribute to performance.

</details>


### [256] [Benchmarking AI Agents for Hardware Design Automation via MCP Tool Calling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26199)
*Leonardo Liparulo,Francesco Pierri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了本地部署的大语言模型（LLM）代理能否在工业级硬件设计工具环境中可靠地自动化专家定义的工作流程。作者构建了一个基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的服务器来复现专有硬件设计工具的状态与依赖逻辑，并建立了一个覆盖多种任务类型的基准测试集，评估了七个开源模型在不同配置下的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬件设计环境中存在大量重复性、依赖有序的操作（如创建组件、添加端口、布线连接），工程师需要自动化这些工作。但由于组件规格和命名约定的保密性限制，无法使用托管式专有API，因此需要探索本地部署的LLM代理能否可靠完成这些任务。

Method: 构建了一个模拟专有硬件设计工具的MCP服务器，创建了涵盖单操作编辑、多步依赖链、无效请求、拼写错误提示和多服务器工具上下文的基准测试。评估了七个开源模型，并比较了系统提示、工具描述细节、上下文范围和单代理与多代理架构等管线选择。

Result: 强大的模型在基准工作流上可以达到接近完整的期望调用覆盖率，但可靠性强烈依赖于任务结构和代理配置。详细的工具描述能持续减少失败；少样本提示可能导致某些模型严重不作为；累积上下文会损害受限模型的性能；多代理分解可以帮助弱模型或长时间会话，但代价是额外调用次数增加。

Conclusion: 研究为在状态化硬件设计环境中部署本地LLM代理提供了实用指导，强调了代理配置对任务可靠性的关键影响。

Abstract: We ask whether AI agents powered by locally deployed large language models can reliably automate expert-defined hardware design workflows in an industry-realistic tool-calling setting. In these environments, engineers issue repetitive, dependency-ordered operations---such as creating components, adding ports, and wiring connections---through specialised tools. Confidentiality constraints on component specifications and naming conventions often preclude hosted proprietary APIs, motivating the use of locally deployed models. To study this setting, we build a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that reproduces the state and dependency logic of a proprietary hardware design tool used in embedded system development and construct a benchmark covering single-operation edits, multi-step dependency chains, invalid requests, misspelled prompts, and multi-server tool contexts. We evaluate seven open-source models comparing pipeline choices including system prompts, tool-description detail, context scope, and single-agent versus multi-agent architectures. Results show that strong models can achieve near-complete expected-call coverage on the benchmarked workflows, but reliability depends strongly on both task structure and agent configuration. Comprehensive tool descriptions consistently reduce failures, few-shot prompting can cause severe inaction for some models, cumulative context harms constrained models, and multi-agent decomposition helps weak workers or long sessions at the cost of additional calls. These findings provide practical guidance for deploying local LLM agents in stateful hardware design environments.

</details>


### [257] [AffectOmni: RL-Verifiable People-Centric Grounded Affective Reasoning for Social and Art-Related Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26193)
*Yibo Wang,Rui Yang,Jisheng Dang,Bimei Wang,Yitao Wu,Pengfei Cao,Wencan Zhang,Hong Peng,Bin Hu,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AffectOmni是一个基于GRPO训练的多模态情感推理框架，通过引入People Focus和Temporal Order奖励机制，并结合组内比较评分来增强奖励判别力，同时利用Thinking Summarizer和SAM3将推理过程转化为可外部审计的像素级证据，在多个基准上超越7B开源模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在VQA和场景理解上表现强劲，但在情感推理中容易产生捷径行为——模型可能给出正确答案却忽略微表情、肢体语言等人为中心线索，导致可追溯性和外部验证性不足。以往RL方法主要奖励上下文或逻辑连贯性，没有明确强制模型关注人类证据；同时LLM作为裁判的评分常出现分数聚集问题，降低奖励判别力。

Method: 1) 提出People Focus和Temporal Order两种奖励，分别鼓励以人为中心的证据选择和时间结构化推理；2) 采用组内比较评分（within-group comparative scoring）生成更稳定且有判别力的奖励信号；3) 引入Thinking Summarizer将自由文本推理转换为可执行的证据指令，并通过SAM3将其落地到像素级证据区域，在训练循环之外提供可外部审计的接口。

Result: 在IntentBench、DailyOmni和WorldSense数据集上与7B规模开源基线相比有一致提升，其中情感识别提升4.66%，时间敏感任务提升14.29%。

Conclusion: AffectOmni通过显式奖励人为中心证据与时间结构化推理，配合组内比较评分和像素级证据验证机制，有效缓解了MLLM情感推理中的捷径行为，提升了推理的可溯源性、判别力和可验证性。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on VQA and scene understanding, yet affective reasoning remains vulnerable to shortcut behavior. Models may predict correct answers while neglecting people-centric cues such as micro expressions and body language, which weakens traceability and external verification. Prior reinforcement learning approaches mainly reward context or logical coherence without explicitly enforcing attention to human evidence. In addition, LLM as a Judge scoring often suffers from score clustering, which reduces reward discriminability. We propose AffectOmni, a GRPO trained framework for verifiable affective reasoning. AffectOmni introduces People Focus and Temporal Order rewards to encourage people-centric evidence selection and temporally structured reasoning, and it adopts within-group comparative scoring to produce more stable and discriminative reward signals. For verification, a Thinking Summarizer converts free form rationales into executable evidence instructions, which are grounded into pixel level evidence regions via SAM3 to provide an externally auditable interface outside the training loop. Experiments on IntentBench, Daily Omni, and WorldSense show consistent improvements over open source 7B scale baselines, including gains of 4.66% on emotion recognition and +14.29% on temporally sensitive tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/eliot127825-rgb/AffectOmni_nobody.

</details>


### [258] [Same Model, Different Harness: Different Coding-Agent Results](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26218)
*Sydney Lewis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究编码智能体中"护栏"（harness）对结果的影响。在模型和任务固定不变的情况下，仅改变护栏配置（压缩旧工具结果、应对重复或停滞工作），在多个编程基准上显著提升了任务完成率（如在SWE-bench Verified上，F2PF从28%提升到49%，完整解决方案从43提升到72），且该改进对多种模型均有效。作者主张编码智能体评估应将模型和护栏视为一个整体求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体由模型和护栏（harness）共同组成，护栏决定了模型能看到什么、能用什么工具以及工作如何持续进行。但现有研究往往关注模型本身的改进，忽视了护栏对最终结果的影响。作者希望通过实验回答：固定模型和任务时，改变护栏是否会改变结果？

Method: 在三个编码基准（SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Pro、FeatureBench）上对比同一护栏的两种配置：对照组按时间顺序提供完整对话记录；处理组保持相同记录，但机械性地缩短较旧的工具结果（随上下文填满而压缩），并对重复或停滞的工作做出响应。在紧上下文窗口（20,480 token）下进行对比实验，同时测试了多种不同设计的模型。

Result: 紧上下文条件下，处理组在三种压力比较中均提升了每任务平均F2PF，并在SWE-bench Verified和Pro上增加了完整解决方案数量。在169个任务、20,480 token窗口的紧窗口Verified比较中，F2PF从28%提升至49%，完整解决方案从43增至72。该冻结处理方案无需模型特定调参即可在另外三种模型上复现提升。在宽窗口Qwen3.6比较中，Verified和Pro上两组结果接近，FeatureBench上处理组仍保持更高F2PF，且处理组每轮输入更少的提示token。

Conclusion: 改变护栏确实能在模型权重不变的情况下改变编码智能体的能力表现。因此，编码智能体的评估应当将模型和护栏作为一个整体（测试求解器）来对待，而不应仅关注模型本身。

Abstract: A coding agent combines a model with a harness, which decides what the model sees, which tools it can use, and how the work continues. We ask whether changing the harness changes the result when the model and task stay fixed. We compare two configurations of the same harness on three coding benchmarks. The control supplies the full conversation in time order, while the treatment keeps the same record but mechanically shortens older tool results as the context fills and responds to repeated or stalled work.
  Under tight context, the treatment raises mean per-task fail-to-pass fraction (F2PF) in all three pressure comparisons and increases complete solutions on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro. The tight-window Verified comparison uses 169 tasks, a 20,480-token window, and a fixed 480-second attempt endpoint; on this cohort, treatment raises mean per-task F2PF from 28 percent to 49 percent and complete solutions from 43 to 72. Without model-specific retuning, the same frozen treatment also raises both endpoints on the same cohort for three additional models with different designs. In the wide-window Qwen3.6 comparisons, observed arm outcomes are close on Verified and Pro, while FeatureBench retains a higher mean per-task F2PF under treatment. On the wide-window Verified cohort, treatment also serves fewer prompt tokens per turn. Because changing the harness changed what unchanged model weights could accomplish, coding-agent evaluations should treat the model and harness together as the tested solver.

</details>


### [259] [Agentic AI for operating scientific instruments for nanoscale characterization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26198)
*Zahra Ayar,Marcos Penedo,Mahdi Mehdikhani,Nahid Hosseini,Prabhu Prasad Swain,Georg E. Fantner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于智能体AI（agentic-AI）的框架，通过Model Context Protocol (MCP) 连接大语言模型与原子力显微镜（AFM）功能，实现了从自然语言指令到仪器命令、图像质量评估与参数调整、图像伪影诊断与后处理的完整自动化工作流。该框架包含三个MCP代理（AFM Messenger、AFM Pilot、AFM Doctor），并通过歧义检查层确保硬件安全。实验证明该框架在图像质量、迭代次数和调节时间上与专家操作无显著差异，且守卫生执行层将错误命令执行降至零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 操作AFM等科学仪器需要持续的专家决策，现有自动化仅覆盖工作流的局部环节（硬编码程序、任务特定控制器或训练好的机器学习模型），缺乏一个通用、可扩展且安全的完整自动化方案。作者希望通过大语言模型连接仪器功能，实现端到端的智能体化科学仪器操作。

Method: 框架由三个基于MCP的智能体组成：(1) AFM Messenger将自然语言指令转换为经过校验的仪器命令；(2) AFM Pilot通过LLM评估图像质量并自适应调整成像参数；(3) AFM Doctor诊断图像伪影并应用预设工具集进行透明后处理。在执行前增加歧义检查层以保障硬件操作安全。图像评估由LLM完成而非固定标量目标或外部优化器，从而无需针对不同样品类型和成像模式重新训练。

Result: 与微调模型和现成工具使用模型的基准测试表明，守卫生执行层（而非仅模型能力）将错误命令执行降至为零。在实际不同样品的实验中，AFM Pilot在图像质量、迭代次数和调节时间三方面与专家操作员持平，无显著差异。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了科学仪器智能体化操作的安全途径：实验意图保留由人类定义，而命令执行、基于图像的参数调节和后处理可委托给AI智能体，且不影响操作质量。

Abstract: Operating a scientific instrument such as an atomic force microscope (AFM) requires continuous expert decision-making. A trained user defines the experimental intent, translates it into instrument commands, assesses incoming data, adjusts imaging parameters, and post-processes the final image. Existing automation usually addresses only parts of this workflow through hard-coded routines, task-specific controllers, or trained machine-learning models. Here we present an agentic-AI framework that operates the executable part of the AFM workflow using a general-purpose, tool-augmented large language model connected to instrument functions through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The framework consists of 3 MCP-based agents: AFM Messenger converts natural-language instructions into checked instrument commands; AFM Pilot assesses image quality through a large language model (LLM) and, if necessary, adapts imaging parameters; and AFM Doctor diagnoses image artifacts and applies transparent post-processing from a pre-approved tool set. Because the language model performs image assessment rather than a fixed scalar objective or external optimizer, the same strategy can be applied across sample types and imaging modes without specific retraining. Safe hardware operation is enforced through an ambiguity check layer before execution. Benchmarking against fine-tuned and off-the-shelf tool-using models shows that this guarded execution layer, rather than model capability alone, reduces wrong-command execution to zero. In live experiments on different samples, AFM Pilot matched expert operators in image quality, iteration count, and tuning time, with no significant difference. These results demonstrate a safe route to agentic operation of scientific instruments, where experimental intent remains human-defined while command execution, image-based tuning, and post-processing are delegated to AI agents.

</details>


### [260] [Agent Mesh: Reliability Primitives for Non-Idempotent Agent Delegation - Identity Adequacy and Evidence Adequacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26225)
*Mazhar Shaikh,Anurag Rajkumar Bombarde,Harshal Pathak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对生产环境中的智能体软件交付平台进行了失败研究，分析了147个编号事件、81次运行。研究发现服务网格常用的三种可靠性原语（重试、超时、错误率熔断）所依赖的假设在实践中全部被违反，并量化了后果。文章识别出两个跨领域根因：身份充分性和证据充分性，并由此推导出七个以委托（delegation）而非消息为执行单元的可靠性原语。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体在编排器（orchestrator）的管理下执行有界的软件任务，编排器依赖服务网格的机制（重试、超时、错误率熔断）进行可靠性管理。但作者发现这些原语所依赖的三个基本假设在真实环境中均被违反，需要一个系统性失败研究来揭示问题严重性并推导新原语。

Method: 对生产环境智能体软件交付平台进行实证失败研究，收集147个编号事件、跨越81次运行，每次运行都测量成本，多数有突变证明（mutation proof）复现失败。通过量化分析违反的三个核心假设，识别跨领域根因，并推导可靠性原语。

Result: 研究量化了原语失效的严重后果：54次连续成功工具调用循环无法被错误率熔断检测；进度信号恒定为常数导致第三次修复必然误判；21个事件跨6次调用累积使正确的幂等组件无法获胜；一次错误路由的失败唤醒了5个组件（本应只需2个），导致3个旁观者回归损坏的正常代码；12起事件中执行层阻止了正确工作，最贵的一起消耗107个智能体轮次且零写入被接受。识别出两个根因：身份充分性（identity adequacy）和证据充分性（evidence adequacy）。

Conclusion: 作者从失败模式中推导出七个可靠性原语，其执行单元应为委托（delegation）而非消息（message），并提出了受控评估（controlled evaluation）的需求，该评估应由后续研究实施而本研究本身不构成。

Abstract: Autonomous agents increasingly perform bounded software tasks under an orchestrator that retries, resumes, and budgets them. The machinery such orchestrators reach for is the service mesh's: retry, timeout, and error-rate circuit breaking. We report a failure study of a production agentic software-delivery platform over 147 numbered incidents spanning 81 runs, each with a measured cost and, in most cases, a mutation proof reproducing the failure. All three assumptions those primitives rest on are violated in practice, and we quantify the consequences: a loop of fifty-four consecutive successful tool calls no error-rate breaker could see; a progress signal constant by construction, guaranteeing a false trip on the third repair round and driving one run from six of six components to three; twenty-one events accumulated across six invocations of one delegation, making a correct, idempotent component unwinnable; a misrouted failure that woke five components for a two-component fault, leaving three bystanders regressing working code; and twelve incidents in which the enforcement layer blocked correct work, the most expensive costing 107 agent turns and zero accepted writes. We find one cross-cutting cause and its dual. Identity adequacy: in five separate subsystems an identity that failed to discriminate produced a confident wrong answer, and two of them derived the corrective rule independently. Evidence adequacy: a reliability decision may be taken only on evidence capable of moving, attributable to what it measures, and deterministic under identical conditions. From the findings we derive seven reliability primitives whose enforcement unit is the delegation rather than the message, and specify the controlled evaluation the study motivates but does not constitute.

</details>


### [261] [GameWAM: A World Action Model for Video Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26200)
*Yuncheng Guo,Zhanqiu Zhang,Yiwen Guo,Weijia Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GameWAM是首个用于原生闭环游戏玩法与GUI控制的World-Action Model（WAM），通过并行视觉与动作生成过程，联合预测未来视觉观测和可执行的键盘鼠标轨迹，实现统一的世界建模与任务策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有游戏智能体直接将视觉和任务上下文映射到动作，缺乏显式的世界动态建模；而交互式游戏世界模型虽能预测视觉未来，却无法作为任务策略。两者存在割裂，亟需统一方案，但WAM在视频游戏的动态与开放交互场景下尚未被充分探索。

Method: GameWAM通过并行视觉与动作生成过程、块因果条件与流匹配（flow matching）联合生成未来视觉观测与可执行键盘-鼠标轨迹；构建同步的游戏玩法与GUI轨迹数据；在每步预测游戏玩法/GUI模式，并采用模式特定预测分布与连续动作归一化处理异构原生控制；采用块周期控制实现长时程交互（超出承诺视野预测、仅执行短动作前缀、基于新观测重规划），并通过细粒度周期内上下文与层级跨周期历史保持时间连续性。

Result: 实验表明GameWAM在任务成功率上与对比智能体竞争性相当，且执行更少的原生动作。此外，文章发现了Low-Frequency Action Source Imprinting (LASI)现象，即在固定条件下，采样动作源的低频成分会系统性影响生成的粗粒度相机运动，揭示了生成式控制中的源敏感失败模式。

Conclusion: GameWAM证明了将世界模型与任务策略统一于单一生成框架的可行性，在原生游戏控制中达到高效任务表现，同时LASI现象的发现为生成式控制方法的鲁棒性研究提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Modern video games combine first-person perception, rapid visual changes, persistent world state, and heterogeneous native controls. Existing game agents map visual and task context directly to actions but lack explicit world dynamics modeling, whereas interactive game world models predict visual futures from supplied actions but do not serve as task policies. World-Action Models (WAMs) unify these objectives, but remain largely unexplored under the dynamics and open-ended interaction of video games. We introduce GameWAM, to our knowledge the first WAM for native closed-loop gameplay and GUI control. GameWAM jointly generates future visual observations and executable keyboard-mouse trajectories through parallel visual and action generative processes with block-causal conditioning and flow matching. To support joint world-action learning, we construct synchronized gameplay and GUI trajectories. To handle heterogeneous native control, GameWAM predicts a gameplay/GUI mode at each action step and generates actions with mode-specific prediction distributions and continuous-action normalization. For long-horizon interaction, block-cycle control predicts beyond the committed horizon, executes only a short action prefix, and replans from new observations, while fine-grained within-cycle context and hierarchical cross-cycle history preserve temporal continuity. Experiments demonstrate competitive task success with fewer executed native actions than the compared agents. We further uncover Low-Frequency Action Source Imprinting (LASI), in which low-frequency components of the sampled action source systematically steer coarse generated camera motion under fixed conditioning, revealing a source-sensitivity failure mode in generative control. Project page is available at https://yunncheng.github.io/GameWAM/.

</details>


### [262] [6.5% of the Neuro-Symbolic Literature Can Be Reproduced from Its Published Artifacts, a Six-Stage Audit Framework and First Instantiation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26236)
*Brandon Colelough,Vladimir Martirosyan,Ishan Tamrakar,William Regli,Aditya Kumar,Anh N. Nhu,Dhruv Dubey,Raj Ambavane,Haowei Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个六阶段的科学主张可复现性审计框架，并将其应用于神经符号AI（NSAI）子领域。审计发现：检索5,497条记录，最终1,304篇合格论文中，仅有455篇具有可验证的公开代码，成功复现85项研究（占合格语料的6.52%），大量复现尝试因缺失非代码工件（321项）或代码仓库不可用（42项）而受阻。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机科学领域存在持续性的可复现性赤字，即使在论文声明"代码可用"的情况下仍然存在，亟需系统性量化这一问题的规模和根源。

Method: 提出六阶段可复现性审计框架：(1)检索并去重；(2)标题和摘要筛选；(3)全文筛选；(4)寻找可验证的公开代码工件；(5)尝试复现；(6)量化复现结果与阻碍原因。

Result: 在NSAI子领域，1,304篇合格论文中849篇无公开代码，455篇进入工件库存，成功复现85项（6.52%），321次复现被非代码工件缺失阻碍，42次被代码仓库缺失或不可用阻碍。

Conclusion: 实证NSAI论文应在投稿时强制提供完整、版本化且永久归档的工件包，以解决当前"代码可用"声明与实际可复现性之间的落差。

Abstract: We present a six-stage framework for auditing the reproducibility of scientific claims across a research literature within the computer science domain, and instantiate our framework for the neuro-symbolic AI (NSAI) subdomain. Instantiating the framework on the NSAI subdomain produced a multi-year audit. Stage one retrieved 5,497 records and removed 3,018 duplicates. Stage two screened the 2,479 unique records at title and abstract, identifying 1,365 self-identified NSAI records, then removed a further 61 at full text for off-topic, non-research, no-quantitative-evaluation, or inaccessible-full-text reasons. Stage three sought a verifiable public code artifact for each of the 1,304 eligible records and found none for 849, leaving 455 to enter the artifact inventory and bounded rerun of stages four and five. We fully or partially reproduced 85 studies, 6.52% of the eligible corpus and 18.68% of attempted reruns. We found that 321 attempted reruns were blocked by missing non- code artifacts and 42 by missing or unusable code repositories. These figures quantify a persistent reproducibility deficit that survives even nominal "code available" declarations, and signal the need for enforced, versioned, and permanently archived artifact bundles in future NSAI publications. We argue that empirical NSAI papers should be required at submission time to provide complete, versioned, and permanently archived artifact bundles.

</details>


### [263] [Five Primitives for Governing Autonomous AI Agents at Runtime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26696)
*Jiten Oswal,John Cadeddu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出企业级自治AI代理部署沿用为人类用户和长期服务设计的控制模型，存在三重不匹配：代理主体是短暂的、行动由模型而非程序选择、群体是被发现的而非预置的。作者主张治理这类代理是运行时问题，而非模型对齐或构建时问题，并推导出五个原语：发现、身份、治理、证明和供应链。论文描述了一个实现，其中代理行动在执行前受策略调解、按租户行动词汇表授权，并记录在哈希链接的签名账本中供第三方验证。作者还报告了架构成本并明确了实现状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前企业部署自治AI代理时，沿用了为人类用户设计的访问控制和身份模型，但代理主体在三个关键维度上与人类用户本质不同（短暂性、模型选择的行动不可预知、群体动态发现），导致现有控制模型失效。作者希望提出一个系统的运行时治理框架来填补这一空白。

Method: 作者从"行动生效前后必须回答的问题"出发，推导出五个治理原语：发现（discovery）、身份（identity）、治理（governance）、证明（attestation）和供应链（supply chain）。随后描述了具体实现：在代理行动生效前通过策略仲裁、按每租户行动词汇表授权、记录在哈希链接签名账本中供第三方在厂商不参与的情况下验证。实现中强制执行点位于请求关键路径上，身份需要每工作负载sidecar，fail-closed调解将可用性事件转化为拒绝。

Result: 五个原语中四个已构建并运行于私人试点中，第五个（推测为供应链）作为独立工具构建但尚未集成到请求路径。作者报告了架构的代价：执行点处于关键路径、身份需sidecar、fail-closed设计将可用性问题转化为拒绝服务。

Conclusion: 治理自治代理必须作为运行时问题处理。作者坚持保留虽未集成但已构建的第五个原语，因为五部分分解必须对应真实架构需求而非恰好匹配已构建的内容。这一框架为企业实际部署自治代理提供了可操作的运行时治理方案。

Abstract: Enterprise deployments of autonomous AI agents inherit a control model built for human users and long-lived services, and the fit fails in three specific ways: agent principals are ephemeral, appearing and vanishing faster than provisioning; their actions are selected by a model rather than programmed, so the set of things they may attempt is not known in advance; and the population is discovered rather than provisioned, because anyone who can call an API can create one. We argue that governing such agents is a runtime problem -- not a model-alignment problem and not a build-time problem -- and we derive five primitives from the questions that must be answered before an action takes effect and after it has: discovery, identity, governance, attestation, and supply chain. For each we state what fails if it is absent and why the others cannot structurally supply it. We describe an implementation in which an agent's action is mediated against policy before it takes effect, authorised against a per-tenant action vocabulary, and recorded in a hash-linked signed ledger a third party can verify with the vendor out of the loop. We report what the architecture costs: the enforcement point sits on the request's critical path, identity requires a sidecar per workload, and fail-closed mediation converts availability incidents into denial. We are explicit about implementation status: four primitives are built and running in private pilots, and the fifth is built as separate tooling and not yet integrated into the request path. We keep it in the set deliberately: a five-part decomposition that exactly matches what its authors happened to build is not a taxonomy but a description of a codebase.

</details>


### [264] [LLM Agents for Time-Series: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26226)
*Yilong Chen,Xiao Qin,Chenghao Liu,Liang Wu,Noelle I. Samia,Kaize Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于LLM智能体应用于时间序列问题的综述，采用问题驱动的分类方法，将所有系统分为四类：预测与推理、数据增强与合成、异常检测与诊断、决策支持。文章分析每类任务如何影响智能体的架构、工具使用和记忆设计，总结代表性数据集和环境，并比较相关设置下的模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在时间序列问题上的设计选择因任务设置不同而差异巨大，缺乏统一的组织框架来指导设计和比较。

Method: 采用问题驱动的分类法（而非按技术组件分类），将现有系统划分为四个类别，并在每类中分析任务需求如何塑造智能体架构、工具使用和记忆设计；同时总结数据集/环境及对比模型性能。

Result: 提供了面向任务的LLM时间序列智能体设计指南，比较了共享或相近设置下的模型报告性能，并识别了未来研究的开放缺口。

Conclusion: 本文为LLM智能体在时间序列问题上的设计与研究提供了任务导向的系统性综述框架，指出了现有空白和未来研究方向。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly being developed for time-series problems, but their design choices vary substantially across task settings. This survey adopts a problem-driven taxonomy that organizes these systems by the time-series problems they address rather than by isolated technical components. We group existing systems into four categories: forecasting and reasoning, augmentation and synthesis, anomaly detection and diagnosis, and decision support. Within each category, we examine how task requirements shape agent architecture, tool use, and memory design. We further summarize representative datasets and environments, and compare reported model performance under shared or closely related settings. Overall, this survey offers a task-oriented guide to designing LLM-based agents for time-series problems and identifies open gaps for future work.

</details>


### [265] [Evaluating human and LLM screening workflows in a conceptually complex scoping review: Recall--workload trade-offs and run-to-run consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26885)
*Nikol Figalová,Lynn Huestegge,Anne Böckler-Raettig*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究在概念复杂的范围综述中，前瞻性地比较了人类与LLM在标题-摘要筛选工作流中的表现。研究发现LLM筛选性能取决于实现的工作流而非仅模型本身，处理配置、工作量、记录级变异性以及人机决策整合都是部署系统的实质性属性。对于高召回任务，LLM更适合用于经过验证、可审计且有人类监督的工作流，而非自主排除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地被用于证据综合中的文献筛选，假阴性可能导致相关研究在全文本评估前被排除。目前缺乏在概念复杂的综述背景下，对人类与LLM筛选工作流的系统性比较研究。

Method: 在一项预注册研究中，对1,131条记录采用多种筛选方式：1名综述负责人、4名经过培训的助理（筛选不重叠子集）、以及7次完整的LLM运行（使用不同模型和处理配置，包括一次名义上完全相同的重复运行）。比较了保留工作量、相对于316条已验证合格记录的操作召回率、一致性、运行间一致性及程序负担。

Result: 没有工作流能恢复所有已验证的合格记录。人类工作流和两个GPT-5.4文件批次运行保留了42.2-45.0%的记录，实现了82.3-82.9%的召回率。Gemini 3.1文件批次实现了最高召回率（83.9%），但保留了56.7%的记录。全一次性配置恢复的合格记录少于对应的文件批次配置。两个名义上相同的GPT-5.4文件批次运行在91.7%的记录上一致，但在94条记录上存在分歧，包括29条仅被一个运行保留的已验证合格记录。

Conclusion: LLM筛选性能不仅取决于模型本身，更取决于部署的工作流。对于高召回任务，LLM更适合作为验证过的、可审计的、人类监督的工作流中的辅助工具，而非进行自主排除。

Abstract: Background. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for screening in evidence synthesis, where false negatives can remove relevant studies before full-text assessment. We compared human and LLM title-and-abstract screening workflows in a preregistered study embedded in a conceptually complex scoping review.
  Methods. After a conservative title-only screen, 1,131 records were screened by one review lead, four trained assistants screening non-overlapping subsets, and seven complete LLM runs using different models and processing configurations, including a nominally identical repeat run. We compared retained workload, operational recall against 316 verified eligible records, agreement, run-to-run consistency, and procedural burden. Because eligibility was verified only for records advanced and assessed in the parent review, recall estimates were operational.
  Results. No workflow recovered all verified eligible records. The human workflows and two GPT-5.4 file-batch runs retained 42.2-45.0% of records while achieving 82.3-82.9% recall. Gemini 3.1 file batches achieved the highest recall (83.9%) but retained 56.7% of records. All-at-once configurations recovered fewer eligible records than corresponding file-batch configurations. Two nominally identical GPT-5.4 file-batch runs agreed on 91.7% of records but differed on 94 records, including 29 verified eligible records retained by only one run.
  Discussion. LLM screening performance depended on the implemented workflow, not model identity alone. Processing configuration, workload, record-level variation, and human-LLM decision integration are therefore substantive properties of deployed systems. For high-recall tasks, LLMs are better suited to validated, auditable, human-supervised workflows than autonomous exclusion.

</details>


### [266] [The Reasoning Tax: Token Economics of LLM Reasoning Across Task Types and Deployment Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26235)
*Sachin Gopal Wani,Ajay Dholakia,David Ellison*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Token Economy Score (TES)指标，衡量推理模型相对非推理基线的边际准确率提升（按生成token倍数归一化），并通过151次模型-基准评估实验，系统分析任务结构、推理强度和部署环境对推理经济性的影响。研究发现任务结构（如顺序推理链任务）比名义难度更能预测推理效率，且推理强度增加存在边际收益递减甚至准确率下降的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仅关注准确率的基准评测忽略了推理模型在实际部署中的核心问题：扩展思考token何时值得其计算成本。缺乏一个能衡量推理边际收益与token成本之间权衡的指标，导致模型选择时无法区分哪些任务真正受益于推理模式。

Method: 提出TES指标（推理模型相对非推理基线的准确率增益，除以生成token倍数），包括配对版（针对具有推理开关的模型族）和近似版（针对无直接非推理对应模型的顶尖模型）。对7个基准、151个模型-基准评估运行进行实证分析，从任务结构、推理努力水平和部署上下文三个维度评估。

Result: 顺序推理链任务（如AIME 2025、LiveCodeBench）呈现高TES，而知识回忆任务（如MMLU-Pro）即使难度高也呈现低TES；高推理努力水平存在系统性边际收益递减，甚至部分场景额外思考反而降低准确率；RCS显示推理开销常被内部思考主导，DCM表明本地部署可改变昂贵推理工作负载的经济性。

Conclusion: 推理模式不应被视为普遍有益的默认选项，而应根据任务类型、努力水平和部署上下文有选择性地启用，形成数据驱动的模型选择规则。

Abstract: Accuracy-only benchmarking of reasoning-capable large language models misses a central deployment question: when do extended thinking tokens earn their cost? We introduce the Token Economy Score (TES), a marginal benchmarking metric that measures the accuracy gain of a reasoning model over a non-reasoning baseline, normalized by the generated-token multiplier. We define paired and approximated TES variants for model families with reasoning toggles and frontier models without direct non-reasoning counterparts. We then conduct an empirical benchmarking analysis across 151 model-benchmark evaluation runs on seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, science reasoning, instruction following, expert knowledge, knowledge recall, and research-level physics. The analysis examines three deployment-facing dimensions: which task structures yield positive marginal reasoning efficiency, how increasing reasoning effort changes TES within model families, and how deployment context changes economic viability. Results show that task structure predicts reasoning efficiency better than nominal difficulty: sequential inferencechain tasks such as AIME 2025 and LiveCodeBench show high TES, while knowledge-recall tasks such as MMLU-Pro show low TES despite their difficulty. We also find systematic diminishing returns at higher reasoning effort levels, including cases where additional thinking reduces accuracy. Finally, Reasoning Cost Share (RCS) shows that inference spend is often dominated by internal thinking, while Deployment Cost Multiplier (DCM) shows how on-premises deployment can change the economics of otherwise costly reasoning workloads. These findings support a benchmarking-driven model-selection rule: enable reasoning selectively by task type, effort level, and deployment context rather than treating it as a universally beneficial mode.

</details>


### [267] [A Contract-Centered Architecture for Scalable and Manageable Agentic Runtimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27086)
*Yaxiao Liu,Pengbo Liu,Yiwen Liu,Yihua Guan,Zhenghe Hou,Jiaxing Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向企业级AI部署的契约约束型运行时架构，定义了四个责任对象（Skill、Harness、Scaffold和数据子层）作为组织间共享契约，并提出一个可证伪的核心假设P1（成本感知的能力-容量可分离性），同时设计了一个簇周期随机交叉实验协议来判定该假设是否成立。论文目前尚未报告任何实现、实验或测量结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业AI部署本质上是跨业务部门、AI团队、测试、平台工程、基础设施、安全、运营和数据治理等多方的协调问题。现有的用例基准只能衡量单个智能体是否完成单个任务，无法回答能力、模型、运行时机制、容量和企业数据应如何共同被拥有、变更、准入和取证的问题。因此需要一套组织层面的共享契约与可度量的验证机制。

Method: 本文提出四个责任对象作为组织契约：Skill（可复用的版本化能力与工作流资产）、Harness（运行时编译器与治理器）、Scaffold（执行/控制边界及NFR所有者）以及栈外、由CIO治理语义与遥测的独立数据子层。运行时核心为A=<S,H,X>。核心贡献是单条有界可证伪假设P1（成本感知能力-容量可分离性），并定义了六个设计条件作为可度量义务。实验设计采用簇周期随机交叉试验（平衡顺序、重置/洗脱、重复种子与故障场景、簇感知不确定性），输出四态判定：支持、证伪、条件工程、不确定。

Result: 本文不报告已完成的实现、实验、数据集或测量结果，属于架构提案与方法论文献。其"结果"体现为：提出了契约约束的运行时架构、源保持的数据子层，以及可证伪的测量协议和四态判定机制。

Conclusion: 该论文的核心结论是：企业级AI部署需要一个契约约束的运行时架构与可证伪的实验协议来系统化地验证AI能力与容量之间的关系。P1假设与六项设计条件构成了可度量的验证框架，但该框架的有效性尚待后续实现与实验数据验证。

Abstract: Enterprise AI deployment is a coordination problem across business units, application and AI teams, testing, platform engineering, infrastructure, security, operations, and data governance. Use-case benchmarks show whether one agent completes one task, but not how changing capabilities, models, runtime mechanisms, capacity, and enterprise data should be owned, changed, admitted, or evidenced together.
  We present four responsibility objects as shared organizational contracts: Skill (reusable, versioned capability and workflow asset), Harness (runtime compiler and governor), Scaffold (execution/control boundary and NFR owner), and a stack-external data substrate under independent CIO-governed semantics and telemetry. The runtime core is A = <S, H, X>, with the data substrate outside that stack.
  The central contribution is one bounded, falsifiable hypothesis, P1 (cost-aware capability-capacity separability): within a declared operating region, changing activated capability preserves the capacity-response interaction within a preregistered equivalence margin, while changing compatible Scaffold capacity preserves capability semantics up to a non-inferiority margin, and the required controls stay within a declared enforcement budget. Six design conditions become measured obligations whose coverage, violations, uncertainty, cost, and exclusions determine whether P1 is decidable.
  We propose a cluster-period randomized crossover experiment (balanced order, reset/washout, repeated seeds and failure regimes, cluster-aware uncertainty) with a four-state verdict: supported, falsified, conditional-engineering, or inconclusive. This paper contributes a contract-bounded runtime architecture, a source-preserving data substrate, and a falsifiable measurement protocol. It reports no completed implementation, experiment, dataset, or measured result.

</details>


### [268] [SKILL.state: Scalable Long-Horizon Agent Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26263)
*Sanket Badhe,Priyanka Tiwari,Jonghyun Chung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SKILL.state是一种新型的智能体运行时架构，用显式、可变的执行状态替代传统的追加式对话历史，在每个执行步骤中仅向模型提供不可变的技能规范、当前结构化执行状态和最新观测结果，中间推理被立即丢弃。该架构在多个数据集、模型和执行环境中显著提升任务准确率并大幅降低累计token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型智能体在长时间运行复杂程序性技能时，依赖不断追加观测、动作和中间推理的对话历史，导致延迟退化和上下文中毒（context-poisoning）问题，从而在长时域任务中表现不佳。

Method: 提出SKILL.state运行时架构，用显式可变的执行状态替代追加式对话历史。每个执行步骤中，模型仅接收三类输入：不可变的技能规范、当前结构化执行状态和最新观测结果。中间推理在产生经过验证的状态更新后立即丢弃，防止提示随执行历史增长。

Result: 在多样化的数据集、模型和执行环境中，SKILL.state在提升任务准确率的同时，大幅降低了累计token消耗，验证了显式执行状态作为可扩展长时域智能体技能的有效且架构无关的抽象。

Conclusion: 显式执行状态是一种有效的、架构无关的抽象，能够解决长时域智能体执行中的可扩展性问题，为智能体运行时设计提供了新范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as autonomous agents executing complex, long-running procedural skills. Existing agent runtimes maintain execution by continually appending observations, actions, and intermediate reasoning traces to an ever-growing conversation history, causing latency degradation and context-poisoning failures over long horizons. We present SKILL.state, a runtime architecture that replaces append-only conversational history with an explicit, mutable execution state. At each execution step, the model receives only the immutable skill specification, the current structured execution state, and the latest observation. Intermediate reasoning is discarded immediately after producing a validated state update, preventing prompt growth with execution history. Across diverse datasets, models, and execution environments, SKILL.state improves task accuracy while substantially reducing cumulative token consumption. Our results demonstrate that explicit execution state is an effective and architecture-agnostic abstraction for scalable long-horizon agent skills.

</details>


### [269] [When Tool Outputs Become Commands: Separating Action Induction from Runtime Authorization in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27146)
*Xiaokun Guo,Zhen Xu,Dongdong Huo,Yanqiu Zhang,Wei Wang,Qinfu Yang,Dongjin Yu,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SARA 是一个针对工具增强型 LLM 智能体的安全框架，通过将"动作归纳"（action induction）与"执行授权"（execution authorization）分离为不同运行时角色，防止工具输出中的"命令"驱动超出用户意图的真实世界副作用。在 AgentDojo 和 AgentDyn 基准上，SARA 将攻击成功率（ASR）限制在不超过 0.63%，同时保持有竞争力的任务效用，并在多个智能体骨干上持续降低 ASR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具增强型 LLM 智能体必须依赖不可信的运行时观测来完成开放任务，但当工具输出不再仅仅提供数据、而是开始指定具体动作时，它们实际上成为能够驱动超出用户意图的真实世界副作用的"命令"。作者认为这一风险源于将"动作归纳"与"执行授权"混为一谈。

Method: SARA 将动作归纳与执行授权视为不同的运行时角色，并分离动作来源与执行权威。在观测侧，通过上下文隔离的 Action Probe 暴露动作归纳语义，并跨步骤持久记录动作来源作为审查信号；在执行侧，实际工具调用仅依据用户目标及来自已授权成功执行的审计证据进行授权，同时满足目标级、执行链级和参数级支持。此外，SARA 应用 No-History-Promotion 机制防止历史重复将动作来源"洗白"为执行权威。

Result: 在 AgentDojo 和 AgentDyn 基准的四个主要评估设置中，SARA 将攻击成功率限制在不超过 0.63%，同时保持有竞争力的任务效用，并在额外的智能体骨干上持续降低 ASR。

Conclusion: SARA 通过严格分离动作归纳与执行授权，为工具增强型 LLM 智能体提供了一种有效的对抗"命令注入"攻击的安全方案，在不显著牺牲任务效用的前提下大幅降低攻击成功率。

Abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents must rely on untrusted runtime Observations to complete open-ended tasks; however, when tool outputs no longer merely provide data but begin to specify concrete actions, they effectively become ``commands'' that can drive real-world side effects beyond user intent. We argue that this risk arises from conflating action induction with execution authorization. To address this distinction, we propose SARA, which treats action induction and execution authorization as distinct runtime roles and separates action provenance from execution authority. On the Observation side, a context-isolated Action Probe exposes action-inducing semantics and persistently records action-origin provenance across steps as a review signal; on the execution side, actual tool calls are authorized only against the user objective and audited evidence from authorized successful executions, while satisfying goal, execution-chain, and argument-level support. To preserve this separation across multi-step execution, SARA applies No-History-Promotion to prevent historical recurrence from laundering action origins into execution authority. Across AgentDojo and AgentDyn, SARA limits ASR to no more than \(0.63\%\) across four primary evaluation settings while maintaining competitive task utility, and consistently reduces ASR across additional Agent backbones.

</details>


### [270] [Assessing mentalization in humans and large language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26291)
*Aamir Sohail,Xintong Zhong,Arkady Konovalov,Patricia L. Lockwood,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究使用两种经济博弈和认知计算建模，系统评估了多种大型语言模型（LLM）的心理化（mentalization）能力——即推断他人信念和意图以指导自身选择的能力。研究测试了四种模型家族共2,099个LLM智能体，并将其与251名人类参与者进行对比。结果显示LLM表现出清晰的行为和计算层面的心理化特征，但不同模型提供商和模型大小之间存在显著差异；策略性提示通常能提升表现；GPT-5智能体能灵活调整递归推理深度，表现优于人类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM在理论心智任务上表现出与人类一致的行为，但尚不清楚这些模型是否能在实际社会互动中通过心理化来指导适应性行为。作者希望超越简单的行为一致性验证，深入到潜在策略层面，揭示LLM心理化的底层计算机制。

Method: 使用两种经济博弈（economic games）结合认知计算建模来揭示LLM心理化的潜在策略。测试了DeepSeek、GPT-4.1、GPT-5和Gemini 2.0 Flash四种模型家族的2,099个LLM智能体，面对不同复杂度的对手；同时考察了一种旨在引发策略性推理的提示策略对表现的提升效果，并以251名人类参与者的数据作为对比基准。

Result: 两种博弈中LLM均展现出清晰的心理化行为和计算特征，但差异因模型提供商和模型大小而异；策略性提示总体上提升了表现，但提升幅度因任务而异；GPT-5智能体能够灵活调整递归推理深度以适应更复杂的对手，其表现优于人类参与者。

Conclusion: 不同LLM的心理化能力存在显著差异；认知计算建模是一种正式的、可用的方法，用于评估人类与机器之间的比较智能。

Abstract: Mentalization - the ability to infer others' beliefs and intentions to guide one's own choices - is a key cognitive function underlying human social interactions. Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate behaviour consistent with humans on theory-of-mind tasks, yet whether these models can guide adaptive behaviour through mentalization is unknown. Here we use two economic games with cognitive computational modeling to uncover the latent strategies underlying mentalization in LLMs. We tested individual LLM agents across four model families, DeepSeek, GPT-4.1, GPT-5 and Gemini 2.0 Flash (N = 2,099), against opponents of varying sophistication and examined whether a prompting strategy designed to elicit strategic reasoning improved performance. We benchmarked results against human participants (N = 251) as a comparative measure. Across both games, LLMs showed clear behavioural and computational signatures of mentalizing that differed markedly by model provider and size. Strategic prompting generally improved performance by inducing more sophisticated reasoning, yet the extent of the benefit differed across the two tasks. Last, GPT-5 agents flexibly adapted their recursive depth of reasoning to increasingly sophisticated opponents, demonstrating superior performance to human participants. Collectively, we demonstrate different capacities for mentalization across LLMs, and highlight cognitive computational modeling as a formal method for assessing comparative intelligence across humans and machines.

</details>


### [271] [Approved Too Late: Verdict Staleness in LLM-Guarded Self-Adaptive Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26306)
*Ilai Shraga,Roei Eshel,Lior Gorelik*

Main category: cs.AI
