Motivation: 尽管LLM在本体学习方面取得了进展，但仍存在领域术语幻觉、格式不一致、偏向层次关系而非关联关系的问题。作者旨在通过检索增强和词表约束来解决这些挑战。

Method: 采用离线检索增强的少样本提示管道：使用Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct作为基础模型，all-MiniLM-L6-v2进行演示检索（任务A选前5个示例，任务B选前2个）；采用左截断上下文窗口策略保留任务指令；任务B生成的三元组经过确定性词表约束过滤，保留至少一个端点属于样本封闭词表的元组并去除重复。

Result: 任务B：语义图相似度0.8692、术语类型F1 0.9200、分类发现F1 0.8540；任务A：语义图相似度0.7416。但未提取出任何非分类关系。

Conclusion: 该方法在术语类型和分类发现上表现良好，但封闭的、面向分类的关系词表限制了非分类关系的提取，揭示了当前本体学习管道的局限性。

Abstract: Ontology learning from text remains challenging despite significant progress in Large Language Models (LLMs), which can hallucinate domain terms, produce inconsistent formats, and favor hierarchical over associative relations. In the LLMs4OL 2026 Challenge, we address both the End-to-End Flagship Task (Task A) and Ontology Extension Reuse Task (Task B) using an offline retrieval-augmented few-shot prompting pipeline. Our system employs Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 for demonstration retrieval, selecting the top-5 examples for Task A and top-2 for Task B. A left-truncated context-windowing strategy preserves task instructions within long prompts. For Task B, generated triples undergo deterministic vocabulary-constrained filtering, retaining triples when at least one endpoint belongs to the sample's closed term/type vocabulary and removing duplicates of the initial ontology. The approach achieves Semantic Graph Similarity of 0.8692, Term-Typing F1 of 0.9200, and Taxonomy Discovery F1 of 0.8540 on Task B, while Task A achieves 0.7416 Semantic Graph Similarity. However, no non-taxonomic relations are extracted, highlighting limitations of closed, taxonomy-oriented relation vocabularies.

</details>


### [306] [LAAF: A Layered Accountability Architecture Framework for LLM Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27102)
*Prachi Chaturvedi,Shahnawaz Ahmad,Ehsan Nowroozi,Muhammad Waqas,George Loukas,Alireza Jolfaei,Lucas Cordeiro,Pierre Dantas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文遵循PRISMA指南，系统综述了2022年1月至2026年3月间关于LLM（大语言模型）问责机制的研究，涵盖122项实证研究和12项监管标准文档。研究将问责机制理解为"行为者-论坛"关系，解析为五个维度，并综合了技术控制、人类监督、组织治理、文档与可追溯性四大类机制。文章构建了四层分类框架（来源、应用逻辑、人类监督、治理与救济），并将其映射到EU AI Act、NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC 42001等监管框架，最终提出综合问责架构LAAF。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在医疗、司法、金融等高风险领域中的错误或未基于事实的输出可能造成实际伤害，但当前缺乏系统的问责机制来回答"谁应负责"以及"如何追踪、解释和采取行动"这一核心问题。

Method: 遵循PRISMA指南，检索五个数据库（2022年1月至2026年3月），从4,512条记录中筛选出122项实证研究和12项监管标准文档作为主要分析来源，通过四层分类框架进行系统综合，并与主要监管框架进行映射分析。

Result: 识别出问责机制四大类（技术控制、人类监督、组织治理、文档与可追溯性）及各自成熟度评估；发现了四个持续性缺口（人类监督规定不足、缺乏共享问责指标、学科脱节、实证评估有限）以及五个结构性张力。

Conclusion: 提出将分类框架整合为LAAF综合问责架构，并与OWASP LLM Top 10（2025）网络安全对齐；但需强调该架构是对现有证据的综合而非经过验证的工件，未来需进一步验证和完善。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) operate in hospitals, courtrooms, banks, and public service desks, where fluent, confident outputs are treated as authoritative even when ungrounded or incorrect. When such an output contributes to harm, who is answerable, and through what mechanisms can responsibility be traced, explained, and acted upon? Following PRISMA guidance, five databases were searched from January 2022 to March 2026 against four review questions; of 4,512 records identified, 122 primary studies were included, together with 12 regulatory and standards documents analysed as primary sources. The review consolidates a sociotechnical account of accountability as an actor-forum relation resolved into five dimensions, and synthesises mechanisms across four families: technical controls, human oversight, organisational governance, and documentation and traceability, each with a maturity assessment. The corpus is read through a four-layer classification device spanning provenance, application logic, human oversight, and governance and redress, cross-cut by traceability, role clarity, and continuous monitoring. Both are mapped onto the EU AI Act, whose high-risk obligations have applied since 2 August 2026, the NIST AI RMF with its Generative AI Profile, ISO/IEC 42001, and sectoral guidance in healthcare, consumer finance, education, and the public sector. Four persistent gaps emerge: under-specification of human oversight, absence of shared accountability metrics, disciplinary disconnection, and limited empirical evaluation, alongside five structural tensions that no surveyed instrument resolves. The review closes by consolidating the classification device into an integrated accountability architecture, LAAF, with cybersecurity aligned to the OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025); it is a synthesis of the surveyed evidence rather than a validated artefact.

</details>


### [307] [TransMeme: A Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Cultural Meme Transcreation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27127)
*Jingyi Zheng,Yule Liu,Zifan Peng,Tianyi Hu,Yuemeng Zhao,Xinhu Zheng,Xinlei He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对跨文化模因（meme）转创任务，提出了一个多智能体框架。该框架通过专业化智能体协同工作，解决文化知识理解、意图与语气保持、多模态一致性三大核心挑战。在中英双向模因转创任务上，该方法在人类评估和LLM-as-a-Judge两种评估下均优于所有基线，人类评估中实现33.1%的平均提升，LLM评估中以60%的Top-1排名率大幅领先次优基线（26%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络模因是普遍的多模态在线交流形式，但用户来自不同语言和文化背景，跨文化适应模因对于促进相互理解至关重要。与普通翻译或文本重写不同，跨文化模因转创需要同时保持交际意图、适应目标文化并维持图文一致性，这是一个未被充分研究的挑战。

Method: 首先对跨文化模因转创进行显式任务分析，识别三大核心挑战：文化特定知识理解、意图与语气保持、多模态一致性。基于此提出多智能体框架，包含专门智能体分别处理文化适应、目标文本重写、修订和条件性视觉调整，并通过协调反馈机制强化目标文本适应，以处理需要更深层文化或视觉干预的困难案例。

Result: 在中英双向模因转创上，人类评估中四个维度均取得最佳性能，平均比最强基线提升33.1%；LLM-as-a-Judge评估中取得最高Top-1排名率（60%对次优的26%）。消融实验表明各组件均有贡献。错误分析显示剩余瓶颈在于幽默重构和图文对齐，而非简单的文化知识缺口。

Conclusion: 多智能体协同框架能有效解决跨文化模因转创任务，但当前系统在幽默传递方面仍有局限。未来工作应聚焦于幽默转移（humor transfer），以进一步缩小跨文化模因沟通中的文化差距。

Abstract: Internet memes are a pervasive form of multimodal online communication; however, such communication often involves users from diverse linguistic and cultural backgrounds. Therefore, adapting memes across cultures and languages is a central challenge for enabling mutual understanding in online communication. Unlike ordinary translation or standalone text rewriting, cross-cultural meme transcreation must jointly preserve communicative intent, adapt culture-dependent meaning for the target audience, and maintain coherence between text and image. In this work, we first provide an explicit task analysis of cross-cultural meme transcreation and identify three core challenges: culture-specific knowledge understanding, intent and tone preservation, and multimodal consistency. Based on this analysis, we propose a multi-agent framework with specialized agents that are coordinated to address these challenges through cultural adaptation, target text rewriting, revision, and conditional visual adjustment. The framework strengthens target text adaptation with coordinated feedback to handle difficult cases that require deeper cultural or visual intervention. We evaluate the framework on bidirectional Chinese-English meme transcreation using both human evaluation and LLM-as-a-Judge. Our method consistently outperforms all baselines across both evaluation settings. In human evaluation, it achieves the best performance on all four dimensions and delivers a 33.1% average improvement over the strongest baseline, while in LLM-as-a-Judge, it attains the highest Top-1 ranking rate (60% versus 26% for the second-best baseline). Further analysis indicates that each component contributes to the performance. Our error analysis suggests that the remaining bottlenecks lie in humor reconstruction and image-text alignment rather than simple cultural knowledge gaps, pointing to future work on humor transfer.

</details>


### [308] [GRAIN: Bridging Name and Narrative Shifts in Real-World Graph Reasoning through Invariance-Rewarded Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27142)
*Zike Yuan,Han Zhang,Jianzhi Yan,Le Liu,Cai Ke,Huozhi Zhou,Jian Xie,Jiran Yin,Yukun Cao,Yue Yu,Hui Wang,Ming Liu,Bing Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GRAIN，一个基于强化学习优化的单智能体框架，通过结构不变性奖励引导LLM学习鲁棒的文本到图结构映射，在图形推理任务中超越多智能体基线，精度提升16.45%，延迟降低24%，并显著缩小分布外泛化差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在标准化图任务上表现良好，但对真实世界中节点标识符和任务表述的变化非常脆弱。LLM容易过拟合表面模式，而在噪声文本中提取拓扑结构的能力很差。现有缓解方案（如多智能体系统）虽然有效但延迟过高，难以实际应用。

Method: GRAIN将推理建模为语义解析和工具执行的流水线，通过结构不变性奖励（Structure Invariance Reward）进行强化学习优化。该奖励通过验证提取的中间图与真实拓扑结构的一致性，迫使LLM学习鲁棒的文本到结构的映射，而非记忆语言伪影。同时引入GRIT基准来评估对语言变化的敏感性。

Result: GRAIN在多智能体基线上精度提升16.45%，延迟降低约24%；在分布外泛化方面将SFT模型的OOD差距从15.77%缩小到7.80%（减半），并在超出训练分布的大规模图上保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: GRAIN证明通过强化学习+结构不变性奖励，单智能体框架可以在不牺牲延迟的前提下获得比多智能体方法更优的鲁棒性和泛化能力，为LLM在真实世界图推理任务中的应用提供了高效可行的方案。

Abstract: Despite their potential in standardized graph tasks, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain brittle to real-world shifts in node identifiers and task formulation. While deterministic graph tools are invariant to such shifts, extracting topological structures from noisy text is highly fragile for LLMs, which often overfit to surface patterns. Moreover, mitigating these parsing failures via multi-agent systems incurs prohibitive latency. To address this, we propose GRAIN, a single-agent framework optimized via reinforcement learning. GRAIN models reasoning as a semantic parsing and tool-execution pipeline, guided by a Structure Invariance Reward. By validating extracted intermediate graphs against ground-truth topologies, this reward forces the LLM to learn robust text-to-structure mappings rather than memorizing linguistic artifacts. We also introduce GRIT, a benchmark evaluating sensitivity to such linguistic shifts. GRAIN outperforms multi-agent baselines by 16.45\% in accuracy with approximately 24\% lower latency. Furthermore, it demonstrates superior structural generalization, halving the out-of-distribution (OOD) gap of SFT models (from 15.77\% to 7.80\%) and maintaining robustness on large-scale graphs beyond the training distribution.

</details>


### [309] [Feature Transformation Enhanced Jacobi Polynomial Graph Filtering for Graph Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27144)
*Xiang Wang,Zhijun Cheng,Zhenyu Meng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为JPGFN的新型图异常检测方法，通过特征分离变换网络（FSTNN）、自适应Jacobi多项式图滤波模块和节点标签约束模块，解决了现有频域图异常检测方法在滤波器适应性、细粒度特征利用和标签信息挖掘方面的不足，在多个真实数据集上取得了显著优于主流方法的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于频域滤波的图异常检测方法存在三大挑战：(1) 使用静态基函数构建图滤波器，无法有效适应图数据的频域分布；(2) 未能充分考虑节点特征向量中各属性的重要性信息，导致细粒度信息丢失；(3) 对节点标签的利用不充分。

Method: JPGFN方法包含三个核心模块：(1) FSTNN（特征分离变换网络），通过特征分离并对不同维度的节点特征施加非线性变换，以学习更精细的节点特征；(2) 基于Jacobi多项式的自适应图滤波模块，能够自适应地捕获图信号的复杂频域特征；(3) 节点标签约束模块，促进节点标签的利用以增强图异常检测性能。

Result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明，JPGFN方法显著优于主流图异常检测方法。

Conclusion: JPGFN通过自适应滤波、细粒度特征学习和标签约束三者结合，有效解决了现有频域图异常检测方法的局限，为图异常检测领域提供了更优的解决方案。

Abstract: In recent years, graph anomaly detection (GAD) based on frequency-domain filtering have achieved promising results. However, existing approaches still face three major challenges: First, they use static basic function to constructed graph filter which cannot effectively adapt to the frequency-domain distribution of graph data. Second, they fail to adequately consider the importance information of each attribute in the node feature vector, leading to the loss of fine-grained information. Third, they insufficiently utilize node labels for GAD. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel graph anomaly detection method called JPGFN (Feature Transformation Enhanced Jacobi Polynomial Graph Filtering Network). First, a Feature Separation Transformation Network (FSTNN) is developed to better learn fine-grained node features by feature separation and applying nonlinear transformations to node features across different dimensions. Second, an adaptive Jacobi polynomial graph filtering module is constructed based on Jacobi polynomials to adaptively capture complex frequency-domain features of graph signals. Finally, a node label constraint module is developed to facilitate the use of node labels and enhance the performance of GAD. Experimental results on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms mainstream approaches.

</details>


### [310] [Thomson: Continual Learning of Frontier Models for SovereignAI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27147)
*Shengzhuang Chen,Jerrod Parker,Yejin Bang,Andrew M. Bean,Nabeel Seedat,Stefan Winzeck,Daniil Glazko,Jannik Zgraggen,Fangyi Yu,Scott Arnott,Dietrich Trautmann,Luca Ciuffreda,Guglielmo Bonifazi,Davide Romano,Bradley Bell,Kirsty Fielding,Daniele Giofrè,Tom Zielund,Ipshita Chatterjee,Sneha Murthy Ghantasala,Manpreet Nanreh,John Scoville,Maciej Sakowicz,Wassim Seifeddine,Lukas Thede,Jonathan Richard Schwarz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出通过持续学习（Continual Learning）在开源权重模型基础上构建前沿性能模型的方法，使更多机构（而非仅少数资金雄厚的公司）能够实现SovereignAI。作者以Thomson模型为例，展示了在中等预算下实现与多个代际前沿模型相当的性能提升，且几乎完全消除了灾难性遗忘问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿模型的开发被视为少数资金雄厚玩家的专属领域，造成开发者与用户之间的信息、经济和权力不对称。虽然公众讨论呼吁SovereignAI（组织独立构建、部署和管理AI的能力），但缺乏在短期内在不同资金条件下实现这一目标的具体建议。

Method: 利用现成的开源权重模型，通过持续学习（Continual Learning）进行现代化中后训练（mid- & post-training）。与小型微调、提示工程或工具增强等有限方法不同，该方法利用现代训练栈，同时引入保护可塑性和稳定性的机制，在参数上进行最少但高影响的关键干预。

Result: 开发的Thomson模型在智能体任务、安全、法律、税务、多语言和大规模深度研究等任务上与近期前沿模型竞争。评估显示独特的π形性能模式：广泛能力（包括未明确针对的能力）都有明显提升，同时几乎完全消除了窄域领域适配中常见的遗忘问题。性能增益相当于多个连续模型代际的改进，但计算和人力预算远低于通常认为的水平。

Conclusion: 持续学习开源模型使得更多参与者能够拥有SovereignAI栈的大部分（模型、工具基础设施、价值观和数据隐私），使广范围机构能够以更低成本获得前沿性能，改变AI开发由少数玩家独占的格局。

Abstract: The development of frontier models is commonly perceived to be the exclusive remit of a small number of heavily funded players, creating an information, economic and power asymmetry between developers and the diverse user base of modern AI. Recent public discourse acknowledges this concern, calling for SovereignAI (an organisation's capability to independently build, deploy and govern AI use), but offers little concrete advice on how this can be achieved in the short term under a diversity of funding settings. We argue that frontier performance is achievable by a wide range of institutions through Continual Learning on readily available open-weight models. Unlike limited approaches such as small-scale fine-tuning, prompt engineering, or tool-augmentation of a frozen model, our approach exploits a modern mid- & post-training stack while introducing safeguards that preserve both plasticity and stability at each stage, making the minimal number of high-impact interventions on the parameters. This yields gains comparable to those typically seen across multiple successive model generations, at compute and personnel budgets substantially lower than commonly thought, making ownership of large parts of the SovereignAI stack (model, tool infrastructure, values & data privacy) viable for far more actors. We demonstrate this with Thomson, a general-purpose frontier model trained with an enhanced focus on high-stakes professional work. Thomson performs competitively with recent frontier models across agentic tasks, safety, legal, tax & multilingualism, and large-scale Deep Research. Evaluations show a distinctive $π$-shaped pattern: distinct improvements across a wide range of capabilities, including those not explicitly targeted, while almost completely eliminating the forgetting problem common to narrow domain adaptation.

</details>


### [311] [BPMN4CAI: A BPMN Extension for Modeling Dynamic Conversational AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27149)
*Björn-Lennart Eger,Daniel Rose,Barbara Dinter*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出BPMN4CAI，一个符合BPMN标准的扩展框架，用于建模业务流程中的对话式AI系统，通过设计科学研究方法开发和案例研究验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式AI系统在数字业务流程中日益重要，但现有的BPMN标准在表示动态、上下文敏感交互方面存在局限，存在方法论和实践上的研究空白。

Method: 采用设计科学研究（DSR）方法论，系统性地扩展现有BPMN元素，并整合专门的组件来构建BPMN4CAI框架。

Result: 通过案例研究证明了BPMN4CAI框架的适用性和相关性，该扩展能促进自适应决策过程、稳健的上下文管理以及业务流程中透明的人机交互。

Conclusion: BPMN4CAI扩展有效弥补了BPMN在建模对话式AI交互方面的不足，为业务流程中集成对话式AI提供了标准兼容的建模方案。

Abstract: Conversational AI systems, such as chatbots and virtual assistants, are becoming increasingly important to digital business processes. However, the established Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) standard faces challenges when representing dynamic, context-sensitive interactions. This paper addresses this methodological and practical research gap by developing a standard-compliant BPMN extension (BPMN4CAI). Using Design Science Research methodology, this paper develops an approach that systematically extends existing BPMN elements and incorporates specialized components. The applicability and relevance of the BPMN4CAI framework are demonstrated and evaluated through a case study. The results show that the BPMN4CAI extension facilitates adaptive decision-making processes, robust context management, and transparent interactions for Conversational AI within business processes.

</details>


### [312] [Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27167)
*Pranav Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现LLM智能体在面对专业外表的市场面板时，对不可预测问题作出方向性判断的比率从6.5%飙升至54.0%，即使面板数据完全是捏造的，效果几乎不变。问题的关键在于"包装的权威性"而非信息本身。作者定位到"行动/不行动"门控环节失效，而非模型能力或信念问题，并通过540个合成案例的监督微调将承诺率降至0.0%，但该门控在严格格式约束下会崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究为何LLM智能体在不可预测问题上会自信地做出方向性判断，定位失败的具体环节（能力、信念、判断还是行动门控），并验证该缺陷是否可以修复。

Method: 在12个前沿模型上设计递增的证据升级实验（裸问题→专业市场面板→完全捏造的面板），对比真实与虚假数据的效果；通过匹配可回答问题、陈述概率、可判定性分类等对照实验定位失败环节；最后用540个合成案例（骰子、硬币、罐子、计时器）对3B模型进行监督微调，测试门控的可训练性和跨域泛化能力。

Result: 承诺率随"证据包装"从6.5%升至54.0%；捏造面板（36.8%）与真实数据（37.6%）效果无显著差异。模型在可回答问题上几乎全对；陈述概率几乎不变且不及基线；分类"不可知"90%时仍仅0.4%不行动。微调后承诺率降为0.0%并泛化到三个未见领域，但在移除推理空间的刚性格式下门控失效。

Conclusion: 让模型自信行动的并非信息本身，而是包装的权威性。缺陷集中在"行动/不行动"门控环节，该门控可训练但具有上下文脆弱性——部署时必须同时考虑这两个特性。

Abstract: An LLM agent shown a professional-looking market panel commits to a directional call on a provably unpredictable question far more often than one asked the bare question: across 12 frontier models, commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% as evidence is escalated. It commits just as readily when every number on the panel is invented: fabricating the entire display, so nothing the model can see is true except the question itself, still lifts commitment from 24.5% to 36.8%, statistically indistinguishable from the 37.6% produced by genuine market data. What unlocks confident action is not information but the authority of its packaging. The failure is narrow and locatable. Incapacity is not the answer: on matched answerable questions attached to the same panels, the same models answer essentially always, at near-perfect accuracy. Nor is it belief - stated probabilities barely move across the gradient that swings action by 48 points, and score worse than a climatological baseline. Missing judgment isn't it either: asked to classify a question's knowability before acting, models call it irreducible 90% of the time and then commit on just 0.4% of those. The act/don't-act gate is what fails, and the effect is concentrated in a few models rather than universal. Because the gate is separable, it can be trained. Supervised fine-tuning of a 3B model on 540 synthetic cases, predominantly dice, coins, jars and timers, drives commitment to 0.0% on the original cases and transfers to three unseen domains. It does not survive everything: the gate holds exactly when the response format leaves room to reason, and rigid formats that remove that room leave the model confident and wrong on questions it otherwise answers correctly. The gate is trainable and context-fragile, and deployment needs both halves of that sentence.

</details>


### [313] [What Makes Good Agentic Data? An ACE Lens on Data Generation for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27260)
*Xingshan Zeng,Zishan Xu,Boju Zhang,Yuzhou Wu,Lingzhi Wang,Jianghao Lin,Liangyou Li,Yasheng Wang,Lifeng Shang,Xin Jiang,Weinan Zhang,Yong Yu,Qun Liu,Weiwen Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM智能体交互数据生成领域，提出了一个统一的两级分析框架：首先将智能体数据表示为因子化对象(E,q,τ,v)，其次通过Accuracy-Complexity-divErsity（ACE）透镜将数据生成形式化为带约束的分布设计问题，系统梳理了现有工作并指出领域正处于向执行接地准确性、学习者相对复杂性和超越表面多样性的转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体数据生成工作分散在多个领域，领域中心的组织和异构评估方式掩盖了共同的生成机制，并且常将候选构建与验证、选择混为一谈。作者试图建立一个统一框架来组织和理解该领域。

Method: 提出两级框架：(1) 将智能体数据表示为共同因子化对象(E,q,τ,v)，涵盖环境规格、任务信号、交互实现和可选验证器，并按其锚点和依赖结构组织生成范式；(2) 通过ACE（Accuracy-Complexity-divErsity）透镜将生成形式化为约束分布设计——准确性确立可行支持域，复杂性相对声明学习者的能力放置学习质量，多样性控制覆盖度和冗余度。

Result: 通过该框架梳理了先前工作如何验证生成经验、构建与校准难度、扩展行为覆盖范围。文献分析揭示了三大趋势：从表面到执行接地的准确性、相对学习者的复杂性校准、以及超越表面变化或数据集规模的多样性追求。

Conclusion: 核心挑战不在于生成更多数据，而在于随着智能体和环境演化，持续分配有效、信息丰富且非冗余的经验。文章进一步讨论了数据扩展、数据来源、训练机制和自适应学习等方向与新兴趋势。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on generated interaction data to learn how to interact with external environments. Agentic data generation must maintain consistency among environments, tasks, interactions, and success signals while producing experience that is useful rather than merely abundant. Existing work spans many agent domains, but domain-centered organization and heterogeneous evaluation often obscure common generation mechanisms and conflate candidate construction with verification and selection. This work develops a two-level framework for the field. First, we represent agentic data as a common factorized object $(E,q,τ,v)$, comprising an environment specification, task signal, interaction realization, and optional verifier. We organize generation paradigms by their primary anchor and dependency structure. Second, we formulate generation as constrained distribution design through the Accuracy-Complexity-divErsity (ACE) lens. Accuracy establishes the feasible support of grounded and internally consistent data. Within this support, Complexity places learning mass relative to the capability of a declared learner and execution configuration, while divErsity controls coverage and redundancy of data. Using this framework, we explore how prior work verifies generated experience, constructs and calibrates difficulty, and expands behavioral coverage. The literature reveals a shift toward execution-grounded accuracy, learner-relative complexity, and diversity beyond surface variation or dataset size. We further discuss broader directions and emerging trends in agentic data generation through the ACE lens, including their implications for scaling, data sources, training regimes and adaptive learning. Overall, the central challenge is not simply to generate more data, but to continually allocate valid, informative, and non-redundant experience as agents and environments evolve.

</details>


### [314] [Naive Prompt Optimization: Rethinking the Need for Complex Prompt Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27266)
*Yuan Chang,Xiaoqi Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Naive Prompt Optimization (NPO)，一种轻量级单谱系提示词优化方法，仅通过教师模型迭代修订提示词并利用rollout反馈，即可在更少的rollout次数下达到或超越复杂优化器GEPA的性能，且随着教师模型能力增强优势更明显。NPO优化的提示词还能跨模型迁移，表明简单的线性提示词优化可以媲美复杂搜索过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示词优化是实现递归自我改进（RSI）的关键途径，能以较低计算成本获得接近微调的性能提升。然而近期研究趋势倾向于使用不必要复杂的提示词优化器，本文旨在探索简单方法是否足以达到同等甚至更优的效果。

Method: 提出Naive Prompt Optimization (NPO)，采用轻量级单谱系（single-lineage）方法：使用教师模型迭代修订提示词，并结合rollout反馈进行优化。该方法避免了复杂搜索结构和多谱系并行等复杂机制，仅依赖教师模型自身的推理能力来驱动提示词改进。

Result: NPO在更少的rollout次数下达到或超过GEPA的性能；教师模型越强，NPO的相对优势越明显，说明教师推理能力可部分替代优化器侧的搜索复杂度。在交互式游戏中总体与GEPA竞争力相当；GRPO在部分不易进行提示词优化的任务上表现更好。此外，NPO优化的提示词直接应用到其他学生模型（尤其同族模型）时也能带来类似的性能提升。

Conclusion: 简单的线性提示词优化方法能够与更复杂精细的搜索过程相媲美，提示词优化领域可能不必要地过度复杂化了；这为更高效、更经济的递归自我改进提供了基础。

Abstract: Efficiently improving autonomous agents across diverse tasks is central to accelerating recursive self-improvement (RSI) in agentic AI, with prompt optimization emerging as a promising approach capable of delivering performance gains comparable to those achieved by fine-tuning model weights, while reducing computational costs in both optimization and serving. However, recent developments increasingly favor unnecessarily complex prompt optimizers. We introduce Naive Prompt Optimization (NPO), a lightweight single-lineage method that iteratively revises prompts using a teacher model with rollout feedback. NPO achieves comparable or better performance than GEPA with fewer rollouts, and its advantage increases with stronger teacher models, suggesting that stronger teacher reasoning can partially substitute for optimizer-side search complexity. In interactive games, NPO remains broadly competitive with GEPA, while GRPO performs better on some tasks less amenable to prompt optimization. We also show that NPO-optimized prompts elicit similar performance improvements when applied verbatim to other student models, especially across models within the same family. Overall, our preliminary results show that simple, linear prompt optimization can rival substantially more sophisticated and complex search procedures.

</details>


### [315] [BrailleBench: Investigating Multi-Criteria Braille Comprehension in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27268)
*Jinghan Zhang,Fengran Mo,Zhiyu Chen,Xiaoyan Han,Kunpeng Liu,Chang-Tien Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出BrailleBench基准，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在盲文理解方面的能力。该基准包含5,570个实例，涵盖数学、常识和多跳问答，涉及英语以及一级和二级盲文。通过确定性且专家审核的流水线构建，评估了六个代表性LLM，发现盲文理解与表达能力之间存在不对称性，且二级盲文在输入端的表现尤为脆弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM为知识和计算辅助提供了便利，但不确定现有AI系统是否对盲人和聋盲用户足够包容。盲文中的指示符、缩略词和数字表示对模型理解提出了独特要求，而现有评估缺乏对LLM盲文能力的系统评测。

Method: 构建BrailleBench基准：从五个数据集中对齐5,570个实例，涵盖数学、常识和多跳问答，覆盖英语及一级（Grade 1）和二级（Grade 2）盲文。设计了不同配置以测试系统理解盲文内容、用盲文表达答案以及端到端盲文交互的能力。通过自建的Braille Toolkit以确定性、专家审核的流水线构建基准，避免使用LLM生成的数据。评估了六个代表性LLM的多方面表现。

Result: 实验揭示了印刷英语能力与盲文可访问性之间的持续差距。盲文理解和表达呈现不对称性，其中二级盲文在输入端比一级盲文更脆弱，而完全盲文的请求会进一步降低性能。

Conclusion: 研究结果为未来盲文AI系统的开发提供了有价值的指导，所有BrailleBench相关资源均已公开，可供后续研究使用。

Abstract: Although Large language models (LLMs) mediate access to knowledge and computational assistance, their capabilities should benefit vulnerable groups in the same way. However, it is unclear whether existing AI systems are inclusive enough for blind and deafblind users to access the same functionality through Braille, whose indicators, contractions, and digital representations introduce distinct requirements for model comprehension. To this end, we introduce BrailleBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs in Braille comprehension from different Criteria. BrailleBench aligns 5,570 instances from five datasets, including mathematics, commonsense, and multi-hop question answering across English and Braille Grades 1 and 2. Different configurations are designed to understand whether the systems can comprehend Braille-authored content, express answers in Braille, and complete end-to-end Braille interaction. To ensure the quality and prevent evaluation bias, the benchmark is built through a deterministic, expert-reviewed pipeline via a self-created Braille Toolkit without using any data instances generated by LLMs. We evaluate six representative LLMs from various aspects. The results reveal a persistent gap between print-English capability and Braille accessibility. Braille understanding and expression are asymmetric, where Grade 2 is especially fragile on the input side compared to Grade 1, and fully Braille requests further reduce performance. The experimental observations provide valuable guidance for the development of future Braille AI systems. All related resources in BrailleBench are publicly available for future research.

</details>


### [316] [LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27296)
*Jackie Baek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型能否为规范化的运筹学问题（库存控制、排队网络控制、品类优化）设计有效算法。作者测试了两种LLM使用层级：层级1直接针对单个实例返回解，层级2仅基于问题类别描述和参数范围返回固定算法。最强的模型gpt-5.6-sol在几乎所有测试实例上匹配或超越现有的最优方法，即使在层级2（算法在见到评估实例前就已固定）也能做到。研究发现模型能力在不到八个月内显著提升，表明前沿LLM可以成为规范化OR问题算法设计的严肃经验基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索LLM是否不仅限于自然语言处理任务，还能在数学和运筹学领域中自主设计出有效的算法。此前LLM在OR领域的应用多为辅助角色，本文想验证LLM能否独立充当算法设计者，并评估其作为经验基线的可行性。

Method: 作者设计了两级实验设置：层级1中模型接收单实例并返回解；层级2中模型仅接收问题类别描述和大致参数范围，需返回一个将实例参数映射到解的算法。人为干预极少——只给一个未调优的提示词，模型可使用Python沙盒工具，受固定计算预算限制。测试了三类OR问题：库存控制、排队网络控制、品类优化。

Result: 最强的gpt-5.6-sol模型在几乎所有评估实例上匹配或超过了现有最佳方法，包括层级2的设置。且模型性能在相隔不到八个月发布的版本间提升显著。

Conclusion: 对于所研究的规范化OR问题，单一未调优的LLM查询即可产生与专门方法竞争力相当的算法。这暗示前沿LLM可以作为规范化OR问题算法设计的严肃经验基线，且该能力正在快速进步。

Abstract: We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Human input is minimal: we give one untuned prompt that describes the problem, and the model has access to a Python sandbox tool with a fixed compute budget.
  The strongest model we test, gpt-5.6-sol, matches or outperforms the best existing method on almost all evaluated instances. This holds even at level 2, where the returned algorithm is fixed before seeing the evaluation instances. Performance also improves sharply across models released less than eight months apart, suggesting that this capability is moving quickly. Thus, for the well-specified operations problems we study, a single untuned LLM query can already produce algorithms competitive with specialized methods. These results suggest that frontier LLMs can be a serious empirical baseline for algorithm design in well-specified OR problems.

</details>


### [317] [Verify Smarter, Evolve Further: Efficient Harness Evolution through Behavior-Aware Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27311)
*Jinghan Xu,Yikai Zhang,Aili Chen,Weiyuan Li,Jiaqing Liang,Deqing Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HarnessLens是一个预算感知的自动化智能体框架（harness）进化框架。它联合探索任务空间和用户可配置组件，从执行轨迹中推导候选修改，并通过可归因证据门控在行为相关任务上选择性验证候选方案。在三个harness和四个基准测试上，平均提升held-out性能7.6-13.6%，同时显著降低评估预算消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的propose-and-verify方法在每个固定任务集上对所有候选进行评分，存在两个问题：一是浪费rollouts在不相关的行为上，二是聚合分数会掩盖特定回归。这导致harness适配成本高昂且不可靠。

Method: HarnessLens框架包含三个核心环节：(1) 联合探索任务空间和用户可配置组件；(2) 从执行轨迹中推导候选修改；(3) 使用可归因证据门控（attributable-evidence gate）在行为相关任务上选择性验证每个候选方案，实现预算受限下的高效验证。

Result: 在三个agent harness和四个基准测试中，HarnessLens将平均held-out性能提升了7.6-13.6%，同时比竞争基线消耗更少的评估预算，证明了行为感知验证和显式归因在受限交互预算下的可靠性。

Conclusion: 行为感知的验证与显式归因机制相结合，能够在受限交互预算下实现更可靠和更采样高效的harness进化，为自动化的agent框架优化提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Agent harnesses shape how language-model agents use instructions, tools, and runtime components, but adapting these harnesses requires costly verification. Existing propose-and-verify methods typically score every candidate on a fixed task set, wasting rollouts on unrelated behaviors and allowing aggregate scores to obscure specific regressions. We introduce HarnessLens, a budget-aware framework for automated harness evolution. HarnessLens jointly explores the task space and user-configurable components, derives candidate modifications from execution trajectories, and selectively verifies each candidate on behavior-relevant tasks using an attributable-evidence gate. Across three agent harnesses and four benchmarks, HarnessLens improves average held-out performance by 7.6-13.6% while consuming substantially less evaluation budget than competing baselines. These results demonstrate that behavior-aware verification with explicit attribution enables more reliable and sample-efficient harness evolution under constrained interaction budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/jhxu5214/HarnessLens.

</details>


### [318] [Not All Eval-Awareness Is Equal: Capabilities Framing Predicts Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27340)
*Allison Zhuang,Santiago Aranguri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了评估意识（eval-awareness）并非一个单一、统一的量，而是具有"能力导向"与"安全导向"等不同框架（framing）的多元概念。通过Qwen3-32B在FORTRESS数据集上的实验，发现能力导向的评估意识对合规性的预测与安全导向存在显著差异（+24至+46个百分点），且通过CoT预填充干预验证了其因果性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的安全评估管线将评估意识视为单一量进行抑制，忽视了其内部可能存在的不同语义框架。作者认为这种简化可能导致对模型合规行为的错误预测和不准确的干预效果评估，因此需要解构评估意识的行为异质性。

Method: 在Qwen3-32B模型上使用FORTRESS数据集，通过链式思考（CoT）中的口头化评估意识进行分类，将其划分为能力导向、安全导向、两者兼具或两者皆非。采用CoT预填充（prefill）干预方法对评估意识为负的rollouts进行处理，观察对不同框架的影响。

Result: 能力导向框架对合规性的预测比安全导向框架高出+24至+46个百分点（在所有测试的转向条件下均成立）。CoT预填充干预实验中，11个预填充中有10个按预测方向改变了合规行为，表明存在因果关系。此外，聚合的评估意识抑制率可能变化，但安全相关成分可能未同步变化，说明相同抑制率可能对应完全不同的行为结果。

Conclusion: 评估意识在行为上并非统一的：仅靠聚合的抑制率来衡量评估意识干预的效果是不够的，因为不同框架成分的变化可能导致完全不同的行为后果。安全评估管线需要区分评估意识的不同框架，才能准确评估干预措施的有效性。

Abstract: Steering interventions targeting eval-awareness, a model's recognition that it is being tested, are increasingly used in safety evaluation pipelines, where evaluation-awareness is treated as a single quantity to be suppressed. We show that verbalized eval-awareness in chain-of-thought can be identified as capabilities-flavored ("the user is testing my ability to follow instructions"), safety-flavored ("the user is testing my boundaries"), both, or neither: framings that predict compliance very differently. On Qwen3-32B over the FORTRESS dataset, capabilities-framing predicts compliance with a +24 to +46 percentage-point gap over safety-framing across all tested steering conditions. A CoT-prefill intervention on eval-awareness-negative rollouts suggests the link is causal, with 10 of 11 prefills shifting compliance in the predicted direction. Then, eval-awareness is not behaviorally uniform: aggregate suppression rates can move while the safety-relevant component does not, and the same "X% suppression of eval-awareness" can correspond to qualitatively different behavioral outcomes.

</details>


### [319] [Sophistication in GenAI Use: Field Evidence from a Large Firm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27364)
*Nicholas J. Hallman,Zachary T. Kowaleski,Anu Puvvada,Jaime J. Schmidt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究基于某大型企业近4000名后台员工在2025年八个月内产生的713,564条AI提示词及响应数据，考察生成式AI使用成熟度的差异。发现：资深员工AI使用更成熟（领域专长互补AI能力）；不同职能间成熟度差异显著（战略、数字创新、项目管理最高）；但成熟度随时间无提升，正式AI培训也无持久效果，表明成熟使用难以改变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前研究缺乏对企业员工生成式AI使用"熟练程度/成熟度"的量化测量，管理者难以了解哪些员工能有效利用AI、哪些领域表现更佳、培训是否有效。作者希望填补这一空白，提供可操作、可度量的洞见。

Method: 利用某大型企业专有数据，收集713,564条员工提示词及其对应LLM响应，覆盖2025年八个月期间近4000名后台员工、15个职能领域的提示词记录，对AI使用成熟度进行系统化测量与分析。

Result: 三项主要发现：（1）资深员工AI使用更成熟，领域专长与genAI能力互补；（2）成熟度跨职能差异大，战略、数字创新和项目管理三个以企业级战略举措和组织变革为焦点的职能最高；（3）成熟度既未随时间改善，正式AI培训也未带来持久提升。

Conclusion: 研究提供了衡量和洞察成熟genAI使用的工具与见解，管理者可据此改善AI应用成效，研究者可在未来研究中进一步拓展。

Abstract: We study how sophistication in generative AI (genAI) use varies among the back-office workforce of a large firm. Using proprietary data, we observe 713,564 employee prompts and their corresponding large language model responses from nearly 4,000 back-office employees across 15 functional areas over eight months in 2025. We document three main findings. First, senior employees exhibit more sophisticated genAI use, consistent with domain expertise complementing genAI capabilities. Second, sophistication varies considerably across functions and is highest in Strategy, Digital Innovation, and Project Management, three groups that share a focus on firmwide strategic initiatives and organizational change. Third, we observe neither improvements in sophistication over time nor lasting improvements following formal AI training, suggesting that sophisticated use can be difficult to change. Together, our study provides measures of and insights into sophisticated genAI use that managers can use to improve outcomes and that researchers can use in future research.

</details>


### [320] [Learning a Continuous Sepsis Severity Score Without Hour-by-Hour Supervision: A Two-Site Retrospective Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27421)
*Kevin Zhu,Ryan Zhang,Baraa Abed,Tilendra Choudhary,Malvern Madondo,Mehak Arora,Yixuan Yang,Alasdair Gent,Aditya Nagori,Omer T. Inan,Krista L. Haines,Patrick Georgoff,Suresh M. Agarwal,Vijay Krishnamoorthy,Tetsu Ohnuma,Mihai V. Podgoreanu,Michael R. Pinsky,Gilles Clermont,Craig M. Coopersmith,Craig S. Jabaley,Rishikesan Kamaleswaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文开发了一个基于43个常规记录变量、72小时治疗窗口的新型脓毒症严重程度指数，使用死亡率作为治疗级别排序信号而非逐状态目标，在两个医院系统共36,807名Sepsis-3患者中验证，结果显示该指数在区分患者预后、与临床指标相关性及跨机构一致性方面表现良好，有望作为临床决策支持工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脓毒症严重程度指数（如SOFA）依赖数十年前建立的固定变量和权重，离散化粗糙，且校准队列已不能反映当代重症监护实践。目前没有直接从患者轨迹学习的替代指标在常规临床中使用，存在改进空间。

Method: 采用回顾性双队列研究，纳入马萨诸塞州和佐治亚州两个医院系统共29,116和7,691名符合Sepsis-3标准的成年患者。利用43个常规记录的变量，覆盖72小时治疗窗口，构建脓毒症指数。创新点在于使用死亡率作为治疗级别的排序信号而非逐状态目标，允许跨时间步非均匀分配信用。使用20%固定测试集评估，通过临床小插图和Spearman相关分析，采用bootstrap重采样获得不确定性区间。

Result: 在0-10分制中，非幸存者比幸存者得分高1.19-1.64分（在各基线SOFA-2分层内一致）；指数随时间变化与乳酸变化相关（Spearman rho=0.39, n=1,854），与MAP和肌酐的相关性较弱；跨机构一致性达同站点相关的70-77%；外部患者内相关性为0.54和0.59（上限为0.92和0.90）；与现有指数相关，而空对照接近零。

Conclusion: 该指数提供每小时预后信息，能有效区分患者结局且符合临床预期，显示出作为补充临床判断的决策支持工具的潜力。

Abstract: Currently used sepsis severity indices rely on fixed variables and weights established decades ago, which are coarsely discretized and calibrated to a cohort that no longer reflects contemporary critical care. No alternative learned directly from patient trajectories is in routine use. We conducted a retrospective two-cohort study on a total of 29,116 and 7,691 adult patients meeting Sepsis-3 criteria from two hospital systems in Massachusetts and Georgie, respectively.
  We developed a sepsis index using 43 routinely charted variables over a 72-hour treatment window. Unlike previous studies, we use mortality as a treatment-level ranking signal rather than a per-state target, allowing credit to be redistributed non-uniformly across timesteps. Evaluation was done on a permanent 20% test holdout, using clinical vignettes and Spearman correlation. Uncertainty intervals were obtained by bootstrap resampling of whole patients. Under this ranking scheme, non-survivors scored 1.19-1.64 points higher than survivors on a 0-10 scale within all strata of baseline SOFA-2, with similar results stratifying within lactate, mean arterial pressure (MAP), and creatinine. Within-patient change in the index correlated with change in lactate (Spearman rho = 0.39; n = 1,854). Similar, weaker correlations were found for MAP and creatinine. On a cohort level, cross-institutional agreement measured by Spearman correlation between models trained on different sites, were 70-77% of same-site correlation. External within-patient correlations were 0.54 and 0.59 against ceilings of 0.92 and 0.90. Our index also correlated with established indices, while null controls stayed near zero.
  Our index demonstrated hourly prognostic information that meaningfully separates patient outcomes and is consistent with clinical expectation, indicating potential as a decision support tool complementing clinical judgement.

</details>


### [321] [Mechanistic Reaction Prediction via Discrete Flow Matching on Graph-Structured Electron Occupation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27429)
*Nguyen Xuan-Vu,Octavian Susanu,Daniel Armstrong,Philippe Schwaller*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MAELLE是一种将化学反应建模为电子占据向量上离散流匹配的新方法，通过CTMC在键合、非键合和氢位点上进行电子重排的马尔可夫过程，在USPTO-480K基准上取得竞争性性能，并在分布外场景下保持稳健性，同时能够恢复与已知化学一致的机理轨迹并预测副产物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习反应预测方法要么通过从头生成产物分子，要么通过启发式图编辑直接操作分子拓扑，这两种方式都没有从本质上把握化学反应的电子层面机理。作者认为化学反应本质上是电子空间的变换，因此需要一种直接建模电子重排的方法。

Method: MAELLE将反应物到产物的映射建模为定义在电子占据整数空间上的连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC），覆盖所有成键、非键合和氢位点。通过将离散流匹配混合路径推广到离散电子重排，并利用最优传输（Optimal Transport）构建中间编辑轨迹，从而无需基元步骤标注即可获得一系列机理可解释的编辑操作。

Result: MAELLE在USPTO-480K基准上达到与领先反应预测模型相当的竞争性性能。在结构复杂度和反应类型两种分布外（OOD）场景下，MAELLE在现有方法性能下降时仍保持强健表现。此外，由于学习到的流覆盖完整的电子再分布，MAELLE能够自然恢复与已知化学一致的机理轨迹，并可预测反应的副产物。

Conclusion: MAELLE证明了从电子层面而非分子拓扑层面建模化学反应是可行且有效的，不仅在标准基准上表现优异，还展现出更强的分布外泛化能力和机理可解释性，为反应预测提供了一个更具化学直觉的新范式。

Abstract: Chemical reactions are fundamentally transformations in electron space, yet most machine learning approaches model them either through \textit{de novo} generation of product molecules or through heuristic graph edits that operate directly on molecular topology.
  We introduce MAELLE (\textbf{M}ech\textbf{A}nistic \textbf{E}dit f\textbf{L}ow-matching on e\textbf{L}ectron r\textbf{E}arrangements), which instead models reactions as discrete flow matching over electron occupation vectors.
  Concretely, we formulate the reactant-to-product mapping as a Continuous-time Markov Chain (CTMC) over the graph-structured integer-valued electron occupation space defined on all bonding, non-bonding, and hydrogen sites.
  To construct the intermediate edit trajectories, we generalize the discrete flow matching mixture path to discrete electron rearrangements using Optimal Transport, yielding a sequence of mechanistically interpretable edit moves without requiring elementary step annotations.
  MAELLE achieves competitive performance on the USPTO-480K benchmark compared with leading reaction prediction models.
  Beyond in-distribution accuracy, we evaluate robustness across two out-of-distribution settings - structural complexity and reaction type - and find that MAELLE maintains strong performance where existing methods degrade.
  Finally, because the learned flow operates over the full electron redistribution, MAELLE naturally recovers mechanistic trajectories that align with known chemistry and can predict side products of a reaction.

</details>


### [322] [WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27454)
*Liyan Tang,Cyrus Rashtchian,Chun-Sung Ferng,Andrew Tomkins,Da-Cheng Juan,Tu Vu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出WikiSkill框架，通过将原始执行经验、累积知识和可执行技能三者分离，并持续将经验整合到持久知识库(wiki)中，实现代理技能与知识库的协同进化。实验表明该方法在多个基准和模型上优于现有技术，且技能进化与模型规模互补，技能具有跨模型迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能自动发现方法虽然能让智能体在交互中逐步适应，但指导技能开发的洞察通常散落在优化历史中，难以跨迭代系统化复用，限制了技能演化的效率和效果。

Method: WikiSkill将原始执行经验、累积知识和可执行技能分离，持续将执行经验整合到持久性wiki知识库中，后续技能更新可以基于wiki中累积的知识进行构建，实现技能与知识库的协同进化。

Result: 在多种基准和模型上，WikiSkill持续优于最先进的技能进化方法，并在大多数模型-基准组合中超越无技能基线。研究发现：技能进化与模型扩展互补（更大模型从进化技能中获益更多，而带技能的小模型可超越不带技能的大模型）；进化技能可跨模型和模型家族有效迁移；其他模型进化的技能可超越自我进化的技能；消融实验证实wiki中持久知识积累对技能进化至关重要。

Conclusion: 系统化积累和提炼代理经验对于开发可复用、可迁移的技能具有显著益处，WikiSkill框架证明了持久知识库在技能进化中的关键作用。

Abstract: Agent skills package specialized knowledge and workflows into reusable resources that extend AI agent capabilities. Recent work automatically discovers such skills from agent experience, which enables agents to progressively adapt through interaction. However, the insights that guide skill development typically remain scattered across optimization histories, limiting their systematic reuse across iterations. We introduce WikiSkill, a framework that co-evolves agent skills with a persistent knowledge base (wiki). At a high level, WikiSkill separates raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills, while continuously consolidating experience into the wiki, which subsequent skill updates can build on. Across diverse benchmarks and models, WikiSkill consistently outperforms state-of-the-art skill-evolution methods and improves over no-skill baselines in most model-benchmark settings. We find that skill evolution complements model scaling: larger models generally benefit more from evolved skills, while smaller models with skills can outperform substantially larger models without them. We also find that evolved skills transfer effectively across models and model families, and skills evolved by other models can outperform self-evolved skills. Finally, our ablation studies confirm that persistent knowledge accumulation in the wiki is critical for effective skill evolution. These results demonstrate the benefits of systematically accumulating and refining agent experience for developing reusable and transferable skills.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [323] [SLM-Conditioned Hierarchical Relation Routing for Labeled Property Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26132)
*Michal Podstawski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SLM条件化层级关系路由架构，将小语言模型整合进图消息选择过程，通过目标条件化路由查询在关系类型内和关系类型间两级筛选消息，实现语义信息对结构锚定预测的有界修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图神经网络将标签属性图上的文本和类别属性表示为静态特征向量，无法根据具体的预测目标动态决定哪些语义证据应影响消息传播，限制了模型的表达能力和可解释性。

Method: 架构包含：1)拓扑GNN提供稳定的结构表示和预测锚点；2)对每个目标节点，汇聚邻居结构状态、节点属性编码、关系属性编码和关系类型构建消息；3)参数高效的SLM处理结构化图软标记，生成目标条件化路由查询；4)该查询先在每种关系类型内选择相关消息，再跨关系类型摘要进行路由；5)最终表示作为对拓扑锚点的有界残差更新。

Result: 该架构在邻居级和关系类型级均支持可解释分析，为将语言派生语义整合到属性丰富的图学习中提供了通用机制。

Conclusion: 通过SLM条件化路由，在保留结构证据的同时允许上下文语义信息调整预测，实现了语言模型与图结构学习的有效融合。

Abstract: Labeled property graphs combine relational structure with heterogeneous textual and categorical properties attached to both nodes and relationships. Conventional graph neural networks typically represent these properties as static feature vectors, limiting their ability to determine which semantic evidence should influence message propagation for a particular prediction target. We propose SLM-Conditioned Hierarchical Relation Routing, an architecture that integrates a small language model directly into graph message selection. A topology GNN provides a stable structural representation and prediction anchor. For each target node, incident messages combine the neighbor's structural state, node-property encoding, relationship-property encoding, and relationship type. A parameter-efficient SLM processes structured graph soft tokens and produces a target-conditioned routing query. This query first selects relevant messages within each relationship type and subsequently routes information across relation-level summaries. The resulting representation provides a bounded residual update to the topology anchor, preserving structural evidence while allowing contextual semantic information to modify the prediction. The architecture supports interpretable analysis at both the neighbor and relationship-type levels and provides a general mechanism for integrating language-derived semantics into property-rich graph learning.

</details>


### [324] [NeuronFuzz: Safety Neuron Guided Fuzzing for LLM Safety Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26222)
*Zhiyuan Xu,Muhammad Firhard Roslan,Joseph Gardiner,Sana Belguith,Lichao Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeuronFuzz是一个白盒模糊测试框架，利用LLM内部安全神经元的激活值作为连续反馈来评估模型安全性，避免了对每个候选提示生成完整响应的高昂代价，在21个文本和多模态模型上实现了76-100%的越狱发现率，并零样本迁移到多个开源和专有目标模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化安全评估方法依赖响应级反馈，每个候选提示都需要生成目标模型响应来评估攻击效果，成本高昂；且对于对齐良好的模型，大多数候选被相同失败结果拒绝，只提供稀疏的指导信号，效率低下。

Method: NeuronFuzz包含两个核心组件：1) SafetyOracle——利用模板不变的有害/良性输入和稳定性感知选择，识别紧凑的安全神经元集合，将安全神经元激活值转化为连续的、可微分的、可在prefill阶段获取的安全警报分数；2) 利用安全警报分数的梯度识别安全敏感的模板位置，并结合掩码语言模型生成流畅、上下文兼容的变异，同时保留原始有害载荷。

Result: 在21个文本和多模态模型上评估。对5个白盒源模型实现76-100%的越狱发现率，比基线最高提升48个百分点。优化后的模板零样本迁移到开源权重模型和6个专有目标模型上，平均ASR和top-5集成ASR(EASR)分别达到69.6%/92.6%和44.1%/60.0%。

Conclusion: NeuronFuzz证明了利用内部安全神经元作为连续、可微分的执行反馈可以显著提升LLM越狱测试的效率与效果，并将prefill阶段的内部状态作为更有信息量的反馈信号引入安全评估领域，同时其优化的模板具有良好的跨模型迁移能力。

Abstract: Safety evaluation is critical for assessing whether aligned Large Language Models (LLMs) remain robust against jailbreak attacks. Existing automated testing methods, however, largely rely on response-level feedback: each candidate prompt typically requires generating a target-model response to evaluate its attack effectiveness. This process is expensive and, more importantly, provides only sparse guidance on strongly aligned models, where most candidates are rejected with the same failure outcome.
  This paper presents NeuronFuzz, a white-box fuzzing framework that exploits internal safety neurons as continuous execution feedback for LLM safety evaluation. A SafetyOracle converts safety-neuron activations into a continuous safety alarm score that serves as feedback for fuzzing and can be obtained during prefill, eliminating response generation from the fuzzing loop. To construct the SafetyOracle, NeuronFuzz uses template-invariant harmful and benign inputs and stability-aware selection to identify a compact set of safety neurons whose activations capture harmful-intent recognition. Moreover, since the safety alarm score is differentiable, NeuronFuzz uses its gradients to identify safety-sensitive template positions and a masked language model to generate fluent, context-compatible mutations while preserving original harmful payload and avoiding additional optimization variables. We evaluate NeuronFuzz across 21 text and multimodal models. Across five white-box source models, it achieves a 76-100% jailbreak discovery rate, outperforming baselines by up to 48 percentage points. Its optimized templates further transfer zero-shot to open-weight and six proprietary target models, achieving average ASR and top-5 ensemble ASR (EASR) of 69.6%/92.6% and 44.1%/60.0%, respectively.

</details>


### [325] [Pruning Binarized Neural Networks: A Dedicated Framework and Globally Weighted Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26233)
*Roan Rubiales,Jean Pierre David*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个基于PyTorch的研究框架，用于设计和优化二值化神经网络，包含冻结和剪枝机制。在该框架基础上，提出了一种跨抽象层考虑参数相对重要性的全局加权剪枝方法，在VGG11上实现了70%的剪枝率且精度不变，而现有最先进方法在二值化设置下仅达到41%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极端压缩深度神经网络（如完全二值化）可显著减少内存占用和算术复杂度，便于在FPGA和微控制器等边缘硬件上部署。尽管二值化与剪枝结合有望带来额外效率提升，但现有剪枝策略不适合二值化表示，且很少转化为实际硬件收益。

Method: 提出了一个基于PyTorch的研究导向框架，包含冻结（freezing）和剪枝（pruning）机制。在该框架基础上，提出了一种新颖的剪枝方法，该方法考虑学习参数在不同抽象层面的相对重要性，通过全局加权机制来平衡模型精度与剪枝率。

Result: 该全局加权机制在模型精度和剪枝率之间取得了优越的权衡：在VGG11上实现了70%的剪枝率且精度保持不变，而现有最先进方法在二值化设置下仅达到41%的剪枝率。

Conclusion: 所提出的框架能够快速且可复现地评估最先进方法并快速原型化新方法，所提出的全局加权剪枝方法显著优于现有二值化剪枝方法，为二值化神经网络的优化提供了有效工具。

Abstract: Extreme compression of deep neural networks, up to full binarization, dramatically reduces memory footprint and arithmetic complexity, facilitating deployment on constrained edge hardware with field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and microcontrollers. Although combining binarization with pruning promises additional efficiency gains, existing pruning strategies are ill-suited to binarized representations and rarely translate into meaningful hardware savings. We introduce a PyTorch-based, research-oriented framework that incorporates freezing and pruning mechanisms for designing and optimizing binarized neural networks. The framework enables rapid and reproducible evaluation of state-of-the-art approaches and the fast prototyping of new ones. Leveraging this framework, we propose a novel pruning method that accounts for the relative importance of learned parameters across abstraction levels. Such a global weighting mechanism consistently achieves a superior trade-off between model accuracy and pruning rate, achieving a 70% pruning rate on VGG11 with constant accuracy, while state-of-the-art results reach only 41% in the binarized setting.

</details>


### [326] [Muon with Finite Newton-Schulz: The Smoothing Benefit in Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26288)
*Mingyi Li,Taira Tsuchiya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了Muon优化器在非光滑非凸优化中的收敛性。研究表明，有限深度的Newton-Schulz迭代（而非精确极分解）对收敛是有益的，因为它将不连续的极坐标映射平滑化为奇异值的Lipschitz映射。通过online-to-nonconvex转换框架，作者证明了仅需对数深度的Newton-Schulz迭代即可保证收敛到驻点，而使用精确极分解的Muon可能无法收敛。样本复杂度界与已知最优结果相匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于Muon的理论要么用精确极分解替代Newton-Schulz迭代，要么将有限迭代深度视为近似误差，因此理论保证无法反映Muon实际运行的算法。作者希望证明有限Newton-Schulz迭代不仅无害，反而对非光滑非凸优化是有益的。

Method: 通过online-to-nonconvex转换框架分析Muon，将更新规则视为在线学习器，利用有限Newton-Schulz迭代的平滑性质（将不连续极映射平滑为奇异值的Lipschitz映射），将Muon视为具有平滑谱势能的在线学习器，从而将遗憾界转化为稳定性保证。

Result: 证明了Newton-Schulz深度仅需随目标精度对数增长即可保证非光滑非凸优化收敛到驻点；而精确极分解的Muon可能不收敛。样本复杂度界与非光滑非凸优化的最优已知界匹配，对光滑非凸优化在问题相关因子下是最优的。结论可推广到具有相同平滑性质的一般谱映射。

Conclusion: 有限Newton-Schulz迭代的平滑效应是Muon在非光滑非凸优化中收敛的关键，而非理论中的障碍。这一发现纠正了现有理论对Newton-Schulz迭代的负面看法，为Muon的实际表现提供了理论支撑，并推广到更广泛的谱映射族。

Abstract: Muon has emerged as a strong optimizer for the matrix-valued parameters in large language model pretraining, approximately orthogonalizing its momentum with a few Newton-Schulz iterations. Existing theory either replaces this iteration with the exact polar factor it approximates, or treats its finite depth as an approximation error, and thus the iteration Muon actually runs can only hurt the guarantees. We show that finite Newton-Schulz can instead be beneficial for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization. To this end, we analyze Muon through the online-to-nonconvex conversion, which views the update rule as an online learner and converts its regret bound into a stationarity guarantee. The finite Newton-Schulz iteration smooths the discontinuous polar map into a Lipschitz map of the singular values, and Muon with finite Newton-Schulz can be regarded as an online learner with a smoothed spectral potential. This smoothing is exactly what the conversion needs: we prove that a Newton-Schulz depth growing only logarithmically in the target accuracy suffices for convergence to stationary points in nonsmooth nonconvex optimization, whereas Muon with the exact-polar update may fail to converge. The resulting sample complexity bounds match the best-known guarantees for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization and are optimal for smooth nonconvex optimization up to problem-dependent factors. The argument extends beyond Newton-Schulz to general spectral maps with the same smoothing property.

</details>


### [327] [Algebraic Multigrid Acceleration for Efficient Label Spreading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26309)
*Antonia van Betteray,Jonathan Klees,Miriam Schäfers,Matthias Rottmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AMELS框架，通过快速构建邻域图和引入代数多重网格求解器，显著提升标签传播（Label Spreading）方法在大规模高维数据集上的可扩展性和效率。AMELS能在单次多重网格循环中跨任意规模图传播标签信息，相比现有实现大幅降低运行时间，同时对超参数选择更鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器学习依赖大量标注数据，但人工标注成本高且耗时。标签传播作为一种半监督学习方法可缓解此问题，但其在大规模高维数据集上的应用受限于计算成本和内存约束，亟需一种可扩展的高效解决方案。

Method: AMELS框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 快速构建邻域图以降低图构建开销；(2) 引入代数多重网格（Algebraic Multigrid）迭代求解器，替代传统的随机游走迭代过程。由于多重网格的多层级特性，AMELS能在单个多重网格循环内将标签信息传播到任意规模的图上。

Result: 实验表明，AMELS相比现有标签传播实现取得了显著的运行时间缩减，同时在运行时间和分类准确率两方面对超参数选择更加鲁棒。该框架能够在大规模图像数据集上高效执行标签传播，即使在仅有少量标注样本的情况下也能产生准确的标签。

Conclusion: AMELS有效解决了标签传播在大规模高维数据上的可扩展性瓶颈，为仅含少量标注样本的大规模图像数据集提供了高效且准确的标签传播方案，证明了代数多重网格方法在半监督学习中的实用价值。

Abstract: Modern machine learning models rely on large amounts of labeled data. However, manual annotation of large-scale datasets is expensive and time-consuming. Label spreading is a semi-supervised learning technique that addresses this challenge by propagating information from a few labeled examples to a larger pool of unlabeled data. Despite its effectiveness, its application to large-scale, high-dimensional datasets is limited by computational costs and memory constraints. To address these limitations, we propose Algebraic Multigrid Acceleration for Efficient Label Spreading (AMELS), an efficient label spreading framework that improves scalability by fast construction of neighborhood graphs and the incorporation of algebraic multigrid solvers. The latter is an iterative solver that replaces the ordinary random walk iteration typically performed in label spreading. Due to the multilevel nature of algebraic multigrid solvers, AMELS spreads given label information across a graph of any size in a single multigrid cycle. We demonstrate that AMELS achieves significant runtime reductions compared to existing implementations while also being more robust to hyperparameter choices in terms of both runtime and classification accuracy. Our framework therefore enables efficient label spreading on large-scale image datasets and produces accurate labels even when only a few labeled samples are available.

</details>


### [328] [Mitigating Strong-Modality Collapse in Multimodal Learning via Inverted Asymmetric Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26879)
*Mary Ogbuka Kenneth,Foaad Khosmood,Abbas Edalat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出强模态坍缩（strong-modality collapse）概念，解释多模态融合模型为何有时无法超越最佳单模态基线（由于主导模态在融合过程中被降级）。并提出倒置非对称融合（IAF）方法：主导模态不经融合直接保留，弱模态将其作为上下文锚点进行注意力关注，融合前用模态感知知识蒸馏强化弱模态。在三个数据集上验证，IAF保持主导模态达到单模态上限，比最强单模态基线最多提升8.25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态融合预期提升性能，但在MultiHuSE数据集上早期、晚期和对称注意力融合均无法超越最佳单模态基线（文本）。通路隔离分析发现文本路径准确率在融合后从74.9%降至56.4%，揭示了主导模态在集成过程中可能被降级，这是多模态融合失败的关键原因。

Method: 提出倒置非对称融合（IAF）：1) 主导模态通过融合层时保持不变（pass-through）；2) 弱模态将主导模态作为上下文锚点进行注意力交互；3) 融合前使用模态感知知识蒸馏（Modality-Aware Knowledge Distillation）强化弱模态。

Result: 在MultiHuSE、UR-FUNNY（文本主导）和MUStARD（音视频主导）三个基准上评估。通路隔离显示IAF在所有配置下将主导模态内部准确率保持在单模态上限，而对称融合在MultiHuSE上使其最多降级18.5%。IAF相比最强单模态基线最多提升8.25%。

Conclusion: 强模态坍缩是多模态融合超越单模态基线的关键障碍；IAF通过非对称设计保护主导模态、强化弱模态，有效解决了该问题，并验证了其在不同模态层级数据集上的普适性。

Abstract: Fusing multiple modalities is expected to improve model performance. However, on the MultiHuSE dataset, early, late, and symmetric attention fusion often fail to outperform the best unimodal baseline (text). Pathway isolation of a symmetric attention fusion model reveals that the text-pathway accuracy drops from 74.9% to 56.4% after fusion in one such setting, indicating that the dominant modality can be degraded during integration. We term this strong-modality collapse and argue that it helps explain why some multimodal models fail to surpass unimodal baselines. We propose Inverted Asymmetric Fusion (IAF), which avoids forcing mutual attention across modalities. The dominant modality is preserved by passing through fusion unchanged, while weaker modalities attend to it as a contextual anchor. Before fusion, weaker modalities are strengthened using Modality-Aware Knowledge Distillation. We evaluate IAF on three benchmarks with different modality hierarchies: text-dominant datasets (MultiHuSE, UR-FUNNY) and an audio-visual-dominant dataset (MUStARD). Pathway isolation shows that IAF preserves the dominant modality's internal accuracy at its unimodal ceiling across all tested configurations, whereas symmetric fusion degrades it by up to 18.5% on MultiHuSE. IAF improves over the strongest unimodal baseline by up to 8.25%.

</details>


### [329] [Privacy Without Regret: Differentially Private Inference-Time Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26324)
*Ishi Jain,Nandini Bhattad,Sayak Ray Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出在Best-of-N采样中向奖励分数添加校准噪声（Gumbel噪声），同时解决奖励黑客和隐私保护两个问题。PrivBoN在隐私预算超过临界阈值ε*时实现零额外对齐成本，PrivITP则结合χ²正则化拒绝采样和两阶段高斯机制，实现与响应数量无关的(ε,δ)-DP，并在实验中验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Best-of-N（BoN）采样是最简单且广泛部署的推理时对齐策略，但存在两个问题：奖励黑客（选中的响应利用代理奖励模型的错误）以及训练奖励模型所需的敏感人类偏好数据缺乏隐私保护。作者希望找到一个单一干预措施同时解决这两个问题。

Method: 1) PrivBoN：在奖励分数选择前添加适当尺度的Gumbel噪声，同时实现ε-差分隐私和KL正则化对齐。2) PrivITP：结合χ²正则化拒绝采样与两阶段高斯机制，实现事后(ε,δ)-DP，隐私成本与响应数量n无关，并将正则化参数与隐私参数解耦。

Result: 当隐私预算超过临界阈值ε*时，隐私要求的噪声即为遗憾最优的正则化，隐私不产生额外对齐成本。PrivITP达到信息论skyline（除噪声膨胀项外）。实验表明PrivBoN和PrivITP具有缩放单调性（BoN在超过临界n后性能退化），PrivITP在同等隐私水平下匹配或优于PrivBoN，在强隐私区间收益最大。

Conclusion: 向奖励分数添加校准噪声这一单一干预措施能够同时解决BoN的奖励黑客问题与隐私保护问题，为推理时对齐提供了一种既私密又安全的方案。

Abstract: Best-of-N (BoN) sampling is the simplest and most widely deployed inference-time alignment strategy, but it suffers from two distinct problems: reward hacking, in which the selected response exploits errors in the proxy reward model, and the absence of any privacy protection for the sensitive human preference data used to train that reward model. We show that a single intervention-adding calibrated noise to reward scores before selection-resolves both. Our first result, Private Best-of-N (PrivBoN), establishes that Gumbel noise at an appropriate scale simultaneously provides $ε$-differential privacy and implements KL-regularized alignment. Whenever the privacy budget exceeds a critical threshold $ε^*$, the privacy-mandated noise is the regret-optimal regularization, and privacy imposes zero additional alignment cost-matching the information-theoretic skyline of Huang et al. (2025). Because $ε^*$ depends on an unknown coverage coefficient, we introduce Private Inference-Time Pessimism (PrivITP), which combines $χ^2$-regularized rejection sampling with a two-phase Gaussian mechanism. PrivITP achieves ex-post $(ε,δ)$-DP with a privacy cost independent of the number of responses $n$, cleanly decouples the regularization parameter from the privacy parameter, and attains the skyline up to a noise-inflation term. Experiments across several language models, datasets, and reward models confirm our results: PrivBoN and PrivITP are scaling-monotonic (unlike BoN, which degrades past a critical $n$), and PrivITP matches or outperforms PrivBoN at equivalent privacy levels, with the largest gains in the strong-privacy regime.

</details>


### [330] [Beyond Capability Benchmarks: Learning Operational Fingerprints of LLM Cloud Services from Production Incident Metadata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26332)
*Meiwei Zhang,Eduardo Miranda,Bruce Baynes,Suvigya Jain,Wanlong Chen,Tao He,Sergey Borodavkin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OpEmbed是一个从结构化、隐私保护的工单元数据中学习LLM云服务操作指纹的框架，无需使用工单文本。它通过八通道操作签名和时间对比学习等方法，在Google Cloud超过33,000个生产工单（涵盖7个LLM家族、26个月）上验证了有效性，支持模型上线、支持就绪评估和操作监控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 托管LLM服务已进入真实生产系统，但模型选择和服务规划仍依赖能力基准测试，这些基准很少反映部署后的操作行为，无法预测实际运行中的问题。

Method: OpEmbed将模型-时间窗口聚合为八通道操作签名，通过时间对比学习、跨视图重构和代际序数正则化学习低维表示，使用结构化且隐私保护的支持工单元数据。

Result: 在Google Cloud超过33,000个生产支持工单（涵盖7个LLM家族、26个月）上，OpEmbed恢复了可解释的家族级和版本级结构，在留一模型外推操作预测中优于非学习基线，在有限的早期窗口数据下仍有用，并支持跨模型故障类型迁移。

Conclusion: OpEmbed为模型上线、支持就绪评估和操作监控提供了实用工具，并报告了构建和评估该工具的经验教训。

Abstract: Managed LLM services are now part of real production systems, but model selection and service planning still rely heavily on capability benchmarks that reveal little about operational behavior after deployment. We present Operational Embedding (OpEmbed), a framework for learning compact operational fingerprints of LLM cloud services from structured, privacy-preserving support-case metadata, without using case text. OpEmbed aggregates model--time windows into an eight-channel operational signature and learns a low-dimensional representation via temporal contrastive learning, cross-view reconstruction, and generational-ordinality regularization. Evaluated on more than 33,000 production support cases spanning seven LLM families over 26 months at Google Cloud, OpEmbed recovers interpretable family- and version-level structure, improves leave-one-model-out operational forecasting over non-learned baselines, remains useful under limited early-window data, and supports cross-model fault-type transfer. We report the practical lessons learned from building and evaluating this tool for model onboarding, support readiness assessment, and operational monitoring.

</details>


### [331] [CG4AI: A Column Generation Framework for Training AI Models Under Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26375)
*Youcef Magnouche,Abderrahmane Driouch,Sébastien Martin,Pierre Bauguion*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CG4AI框架，通过构建AI模型的凸组合并施加线性约束来保证模型输出的可行性。主线性规划确定最优混合权重，定价子问题利用对偶变量生成新模型，并通过切割平面方法将可行性保证扩展到训练集之外。在MNIST数字分类和多商品流问题上的实验表明，CG4AI能可靠地产生可行预测器，且准确率优于单模型基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准机器学习训练仅最小化损失函数，无法保证模型输出满足预定义的规则或约束。在许多现实应用（如自动驾驶、网络路由）中，这种保证至关重要。

Method: CG4AI框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 主线性规划（LP）确定最优混合权重；(2) 定价子问题利用LP对偶变量指导生成新模型，聚焦于最被违反的约束；(3) 切割平面过程将可行性保证扩展到训练集之外。

Result: 在MNIST上展示了四种约束用途（仅从约束学习、提升对抗鲁棒性、纠正误分类样本、强制输出重标记）；在多商品流问题上强制链路容量约束。实验表明CG4AI能可靠产生可行预测器，且准确率优于单模型基线。

Conclusion: CG4AI提供了一种通用框架，将约束满足保证引入机器学习模型，通过列生成和切割平面技术的结合，在保证可行性的同时不牺牲预测准确性。

Abstract: Standard machine-learning training minimizes a loss function over a dataset, but does not guarantee that the resulting model will satisfy predefined rules or constraints on its outputs. In many real-world applications, ranging from autonomous systems to network routing, such guarantees are essential. We propose CG4AI, a framework that builds a convex combination of AI models while enforcing linear constraints on the combined output. A master linear program (LP) determines the optimal mixture weights, while a pricing subproblem generates new models guided by LP dual variables, focusing attention on the most violated constraints. A cutting-plane procedure extends feasibility guarantees beyond the training set. We apply CG4AI to two problems: (i) digit classification on MNIST, where we demonstrate four distinct uses of constraints, learning from constraints alone, improving adversarial robustness, correcting misclassified examples, and enforcing output relabeling; and (ii) the multi-commodity flow problem, where link capacity constraints are enforced on neural-network routing predictors. Experiments on MNIST and standard SNDLIB benchmark networks show that CG4AI reliably produces feasible predictors while achieving better accuracy than single-model baselines.

</details>


### [332] [The Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy: A Framework for Constructing Classifiers and Diagnosing Their Decisions, Applied to Prompt Injection Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26423)
*Jaturong Kongmanee,Smile Thanapattheerakul*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy"框架，通过维度优化的分类器、潜在支持向量定位和攻击令牌诊断分类，构建安全防护层与诊断工具，用于识别分类器自信决策中哪些可被信任，并在公开的提示注入数据集上发现约77%的自信决策对单令牌删除不稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度分类器常以高置信度做出错误或脆弱的决策，但缺乏系统化的机制来识别哪些自信决策值得信任。现有方法通常固定嵌入维度，且未提供分类器失败模式的细粒度诊断。本文动机是构建一个既可作为防护层、又能提供可操作诊断的分类框架，以区分不同失败模式并指导后续处理。

Method: 框架包括三步：(i) 通过交叉验证经验性地选择嵌入维度，构建维度优化的分类器；(ii) 定位约29%训练样本组成的潜在支持向量集合，识别能够改变分类器预测标签的关键令牌；(iii) 利用这些令牌及其攻击强度构建诊断分类体系，将提示划分为安全信赖、启发式偏置、启发式覆写、上下文不足等类别，并为每类提供针对性补救策略。

Result: 在公开提示注入数据集上，发现约77%的自信决策在移除单个令牌后不再稳健。这种脆弱性可区分为两种截然不同的失败模式：置信度校准失败和真正的可被利用捷径。框架为每个诊断区域提供补救策略，并以系列步骤展示其运行方式。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一个端到端的指南，用于标记需要不同处理方式的提示：可安全信赖分类器决策、标记启发式偏置与覆写案例、将上下文不足案例转交人工/安全审查。这为构建更可靠、可解释且可诊断的AI安全分类器提供了系统化路径。

Abstract: This paper proposes a framework for constructing a classifier as a safeguard layer, and for developing a complementary diagnostic that identifies which of the classifier's confident decisions can be trusted. This framework, the Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy, consists of (i) constructing a dimensionality-optimized classifier, in which the embedding dimensionality is empirically selected via cross-validated performance rather than fixed a priori, (ii) locating a relatively small set of latent support vectors (~ 29% of total training examples) representing influential prompts for identifying tokens that alter the classifier's predicted labels, and (iii) utilizing such tokens and their associated attack magnitudes for constructing a diagnostic taxonomy. This diagnostic taxonomy provides an end-to-end guideline for flagging prompts that require different treatments: rely Safely on the classifier's decision; flag Heuristic Bias and Heuristic Override cases; route Insufficient Context cases for further human/safety review. Applying the framework to a classifier trained on a public prompt injection dataset, we find that a substantial fraction of its confident decisions (~ 77%) are not robust to removing a single token, and that this brittleness separates into two distinct failure patterns: a confidence calibration failure and a genuinely exploitable shortcut. For each zone of the taxonomy, we also recommend strategies for remediating diagnosed prompts. We illustrate the framework as a series of steps, demonstrating how each step operates.

</details>


### [333] [FedCMAPSS: A Benchmark for Federated Learning in Remaining Useful Life Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26433)
*Amelia Sorrenti,Matteo Pennisi,Concetto Spampinato,Simone Palazzo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了FedCMAPSS，一个基于NASA C-MAPSS数据集的联邦学习剩余使用寿命（RUL）估计基准，定义了五个标准化任务以模拟从理想IID到极端统计异构的真实工业场景，并系统评估了多种联邦优化算法和神经网络架构，公开源码和数据集以提供可复现的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动的预测性健康管理是工业4.0的关键技术，但RUL估计模型的训练常受限于run-to-failure数据的稀缺性。联邦学习提供了一种无需共享传感器数据即可协同训练模型的范式，然而目前研究缺乏统一的评估框架，导致不同工作的结果难以公平比较。

Method: 基于NASA C-MAPSS数据集构建FedCMAPSS基准，定义了五个标准化任务，覆盖从理想独立同分布（IID）设置到极端统计异质性的工业场景；系统评估多种最先进的联邦优化算法，并搭配多种神经网络架构进行组合测试；公开源代码和数据划分方案以确保可复现性。

Result: 建立了可复现的联邦RUL估计基线，提供了标准化的任务定义和基准结果，并公开了源代码与数据划分，为联邦预测性维护研究提供了公平比较的统一基础。

Conclusion: FedCMAPSS填补了联邦RUL估计领域缺乏统一评估框架的空白，为开发和比较联邦预测性维护解决方案提供了标准化基础，有助于推动该领域研究的可复现性和可比性。

Abstract: Data-driven prognostics and health management has emerged as a key enabler for Industry 4.0, yet the development of robust remaining useful life (RUL) estimation models is often limited by the scarcity of run-to-failure data. While federated learning offers a promising paradigm to collaboratively train predictive models without sharing sensor data, research efforts have operated so far in the absence of a common evaluation framework. To address this gap, this paper introduces FedCMAPSS, a benchmark for federated RUL estimation based on the commonly-used NASA C-MAPSS dataset. We define a set of five standardized tasks designed to simulate real-world industrial challenges, ranging from ideal IID settings to extreme statistical heterogeneity, and conduct a systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art federated optimization algorithms across multiple neural architectures. By establishing reproducible baselines and making the source code and data splits publicly available, this work aims to provide a standard foundation for developing and comparing federated predictive maintenance solutions.

</details>


### [334] [NeoTriFuse: Reliability-Aware Multimodal Fusion under Missingness Heterogeneity for Neonatal Mortality Risk Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26436)
*Jiyuan Tian,Qincheng Shen,Ye Lin,Yu Gao,Haohui Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NeoTriFuse，一种可靠性感知的多模态融合框架，用于新生儿死亡率预测。该框架将缺失率建模为显式的可靠性信号，动态调节模态贡献，整合静态围产期变量、局部-全局时间编码器和患者级统计摘要，联合优化死亡率预测和辅助住院时长目标，在新生儿监护数据上取得F1=0.6736、AUROC=0.9454的竞争性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新生儿死亡率预测面临极端类别不平衡、异质临床风险因素、多尺度时间动态和严重数据缺失等挑战。现有方法通常将缺失视为预处理问题，忽略了缺失本身包含的临床可靠性信息，导致预测性能受限。

Method: NeoTriFuse框架通过以下方式实现：(1) 将缺失率建模为显式可靠性信号，在融合过程中动态调节各模态的贡献权重；(2) 集成三种模态：静态围产期变量、局部-全局时间编码器、患者级统计摘要；(3) 使用可靠性引导的门控机制实现模态融合；(4) 联合优化死亡率预测主任务和住院时长辅助任务。

Result: NeoTriFuse在新生儿死亡率预测上取得F1分数0.6736±0.0216，AUROC 0.9454±0.0056。消融实验表明局部-全局时间架构和患者级统计摘要分支贡献最大，可靠性感知门控在异质观测完整性下对阈值相关指标提供额外改善，敏感性分析显示超参数设置下性能稳定。

Conclusion: 可靠性感知的多模态融合是处理真实临床缺失条件下新生儿死亡率预测的实用方法，将缺失从单纯的预处理问题转化为可以利用的临床信号，为新生儿监护提供了更稳健的预测方案。

Abstract: Neonatal mortality risk prediction from bedside monitoring data remains challenging due to extreme class imbalance, heterogeneous clinical risk factors, multi-scale temporal dynamics, and substantial missingness. We propose NeoTriFuse, a reliability-aware multimodal fusion framework for missingness-heterogeneous neonatal monitoring data. Unlike conventional multimodal approaches that treat missingness primarily as a preprocessing issue, NeoTriFuse models missingness as an explicit reliability signal that dynamically modulates modality contributions during fusion. The framework integrates static perinatal variables, local-global temporal encoders, and patient-level statistical summaries through reliability-guided gating mechanisms, while jointly optimizing mortality prediction and an auxiliary length-of-stay objective. NeoTriFuse achieves competitive performance, with an F1 score of 0.6736 +/- 0.0216 and an AUROC of 0.9454 +/- 0.0056. Ablation studies indicate that the local-global temporal architecture and patient-level summary branch contribute most substantially to predictive performance, while reliability-aware gating provides additional improvements on threshold-dependent metrics under heterogeneous observation completeness. Sensitivity analyses further suggest stable performance across nearby hyperparameter settings. Overall, the findings support reliability-aware multimodal fusion as a practical approach for neonatal mortality prediction under realistic clinical missingness conditions.

</details>


### [335] [Subgraph Filtering for Fair Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26437)
*Haohui Lu,jiyuan Tian,Fangyu Zhou,Shahadat Uddin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SF-GNN是一个轻量级且架构无关的框架，通过在消息传递过程中随机过滤有偏见的边来从源头缓解图神经网络中的结构性偏差，同时保持预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平感知GNN方法主要在全球层面约束表征或预测分布，没有显式控制偏差信息在聚合过程中传播的局部结构路径（如敏感同质性和结构放大效应），导致不公平行为仍然存在。

Method: SF-GNN通过结合敏感同质性、枢纽参与度和三元闭包来识别易产生偏见的边，并在每个消息传递步骤中引入随机边过滤机制，选择性地降低或移除这些边。训练中还加入具有预热机制的统计均等正则化器以稳定优化。

Result: 在五个基准数据集上，SF-GNN在保持竞争力的预测性能的同时实现了一致的公平性提升，相比近期公平感知GNN基线取得了更好的公平-准确率权衡。

Conclusion: SF-GNN证明了从源头（局部边层面）而非全局层面干预偏差传播是更有效的公平性优化策略，且其架构无关的设计使其易于应用于各种GNN模型。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) can exhibit unfair behavior even when sensitive attributes are excluded from node features, because graph topology and message passing propagate group-correlated signals under sensitive homophily. Existing fairness-aware GNN methods mainly constrain representations or prediction distributions at a global level, without explicitly controlling the local structural pathways through which biased information propagates during aggregation. We propose Subgraph Filtering for Fair Graph Neural Networks (SF-GNN), a lightweight and architecture-agnostic framework that mitigates structural bias at its source. SF-GNN identifies bias-prone edges by combining sensitive homophily with structural propagation amplifiers, including hub participation and triadic closure. It then incorporates stochastic edge filtering into each message-passing step to selectively downweight or remove these edges while preserving the remaining graph structure. Training further incorporates a statistical-parity regularizer with a warm-up schedule to stabilize optimization. Experiments on five benchmark datasets show that SF-GNN achieves consistent fairness improvements while maintaining competitive predictive performance, leading to a better fairness--accuracy trade-off than recent fairness-aware GNN baselines.

</details>


### [336] [Toward Equitable Low-Carbon Mobility: Fairness-Aware Demand Prediction for Expanding Bike-Sharing Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26451)
*Man Luo,Yixuan Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FairGIN，一个面向扩展中共享单车系统的公平感知图神经网络预测模型，通过模拟网络扩展训练、基于注意力的知识迁移和公平感知优化三个组件，同时解决冷启动预测和收入不平等两个问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共享单车系统持续扩张带来两个核心挑战：(1) 新部署站点缺乏历史骑行数据，导致基于图模型在动态网络上存在训练与推理分布不匹配的冷启动问题；(2) 历史需求数据可能编码结构性不平等——低收入社区的低骑行量可能反映基础设施不足而非真实需求弱，直接训练会加剧流动性差异。

Method: FairGIN包含三个组件：(1) Expansion-Simulated Increment Training：在训练时随机模拟网络扩展以减少冷启动分布差距；(2) Attention-Based Knowledge Transfer：结合站点自适应温度缩放和正交嵌入对齐，将数据丰富现有站点的表示迁移到数据稀疏的新站点；(3) Fairness-Aware Optimization：引入按收入分层的正则化和公平校准的部署评分，支持更包容的站点布局。

Result: 在纽约和西雅图数据集上的实验表明，FairGIN在多种扩展场景下达到最先进的预测精度，同时显著减少基于收入的差异，且不牺牲系统整体效率。

Conclusion: FairGIN证明在共享单车需求预测中，预测精度与公平性可以兼顾，通过针对性的训练策略、知识迁移和公平优化机制，能够构建既准确又公平的城市流动预测系统。

Abstract: Bike-sharing systems are an important component of low-carbon urban mobility, but continued expansion creates challenges in both cold-start prediction and equitable resource allocation. Newly deployed stations lack historical ridership records, causing a mismatch between training and inference for graph-based models on evolving networks. Historical demand may also encode structural inequalities, as lower ridership in low-income neighborhoods can reflect limited infrastructure access rather than weak latent demand. Models trained directly on such data may therefore reinforce existing mobility disparities. We propose FairGIN, a fairness-aware graph neural network for demand prediction in expanding bike-sharing systems. FairGIN integrates three components. Expansion-Simulated Increment Training stochastically simulates network expansion during training to reduce the cold-start distribution gap. Attention-Based Knowledge Transfer combines station-adaptive temperature scaling with orthogonal embedding alignment to transfer representations from data-rich existing stations to data-sparse new stations. Fairness-Aware Optimization introduces income-stratified regularization and an equity-calibrated deployment score to support more inclusive station placement. Experiments on NYC and Seattle demonstrate that FairGIN achieves state-of-the-art predictive accuracy across diverse expansion scenarios while substantially reducing income-based disparities without compromising overall system efficiency.

</details>


### [337] [Distributed Training using an Intelligent Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26453)
*Nihar Shah,Ben Blier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将广域网（WAN）作为训练的主动参与者，利用组播技术复制出站流量和在线FPGA聚合入站流量，结合新的优化框架生成富同步调度（旋转的岛团），在九城拓扑上验证可缩小与同地训练性能的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨广域网（WAN）的分布式训练面临带宽有限、高延迟和拓扑不均匀的挑战，连续参数交换受限于这些网络约束，亟需新的方法和系统设计来缓解瓶颈。

Method: 系统层面：利用组播技术复制出站流量以缓解出口瓶颈，使用在线FPGA聚合入站流量以缓解入口瓶颈，并将这些数据中心内技术扩展到WAN。算法层面：开发优化框架，生成围绕网络拓扑和这些技术的富同步调度（旋转的岛团），最大化信息交换。

Result: 在基于DoubleZero网络的九城市拓扑上进行了验证，展示了最优调度如何随网络能力变化而变化，表明这些方法可以缩小与同地训练这一黄金标准之间的差距。

Conclusion: 通过让网络成为训练的主动参与者，结合系统层面的组播和FPGA技术以及算法层面的优化同步调度，可以有效缓解WAN分布式训练的性能瓶颈，显著逼近同地训练的效果。

Abstract: Distributed training across a wide area network (WAN) is challenging, as continuous parameter exchange by islands of compute is constrained by limited bandwidth, high latency, and uneven topology. We propose making the network an active participant in training. On the systems side, such networks should leverage (i) multicast technology to replicate outbound traffic and (ii) in-line FPGAs to aggregate inbound traffic, to ease egress and ingress bottlenecks. These technologies are used for training across workers within a data center, but this paper extends them to the WAN. On the algorithms side, we develop an optimization framework that produces rich synchronization schedules (namely, rotating cliques of islands) around the underlying network topology and these technologies, to maximize information exchange. Finally, we illustrate this on a nine-city topology modeled on the DoubleZero network, a live programmable WAN equipped with both technologies, and show how the optimal schedules shift with the network's capabilities. Together, these can narrow the gap to the gold standard of colocated training.

</details>


### [338] [Diff Mining: Logit Differences Reveal Finetuning Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26462)
*Greg Kocher,Robert West,Clément Dumas,Julian Minder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Diff Mining 框架，通过比较微调模型与其基础模型的 logits 差异来识别微调过程中学到的行为。该框架只需访问输出 logits，可扩展到大模型，在微调域检测和偏见识别等任务上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着语言模型能力不断增强，理解微调过程变得愈发重要，因为微调期间可能产生不期望的行为。然而现有的模型差异分析方法大多需要访问模型内部结构，且对大型模型扩展性有限。作者希望提出一种仅依赖输出 logits 的简单有效的方法来识别微调模型学到了什么。

Method: Diff Mining 框架包含两个模块化阶段：(i) 在参考语料上提取微调模型与基础模型之间的逐上下文 logit 差异；(ii) 聚合这些信号以构建可解释的 token 集合。聚合阶段探索了两种方法：简单的 Top-K 频率方法和基于非负矩阵分解（NMF）的方法，后者可将多个微调目标分离为不同的 token 簇。

Result: 在微调域检测任务上，Diff Mining 在识别相关 token 和下游性能方面均显著优于最先进的模型差异分析方法；在注入偏见的模型中，无需针对性探测即可识别出超过三分之一的偏见。

Conclusion: Diff Mining 在开发审计工具以检测微调目标方面展现出良好前景，为理解微调模型的学习行为提供了一种可扩展且无需内部访问的实用方法。

Abstract: Finetuning has become the gold standard for refining existing behaviors and inducing new ones in language models, yet it often remains unclear exactly which behaviors emerge during this process. As models grow ever more capable, understanding finetuning better becomes increasingly important, particularly since unwanted behaviors may arise during finetuning. In this paper, we introduce Diff Mining, a simple yet effective framework for identifying what a finetuned model has learned by comparing its logits to those of its base model. Diff Mining effectively surfaces salient tokens that are amplified in the finetuned model, serving as a fingerprint of its training -- even on text unrelated to the finetuning domain. Unlike many existing model diffing methods which require model internals, Diff Mining only needs access to output logits and scales to large models. The framework consists of two modular stages: (i) extracting per-context logit differences between the finetuned and base models on a reference corpus, and (ii) aggregating the resulting signals to construct an interpretable token set representing the finetune. For aggregation, we explore both a simple Top-K frequency method and a Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF)-based approach for disentangling multiple finetuning objectives into distinct token clusters. Empirically, Diff Mining succeeds across diverse settings: on finetune domain detection, it significantly outperforms state-of-the-art model diffing methods both in identifying relevant tokens and in downstream performance when an interpretability agent is given access to the extracted token set; on models with injected biases, it identifies more than one third of the biases without targeted probing.
